notes.content:

[b]FREEZE![/b] ehem, Hi. 

Hey everyone, and happy Midsummer!

Summer has arrived, and we've been cooking something special for you! We've also made some necessary changes so we can move forward with supporting the game past 2025. To celebrate, the game is 50% off during the Steam Summer Sale. Here’s a quick look at what’s new in this update:

[/p][h1]Pet cosmetics[/h1][p]
We're introducing a new tackle box with unlockable pets that can accompany you on your journey in Longvinter Island! Dogs, cats, and small birds will follow you around and have a bunch of cute animations to entertain you while chilling at the campfire. Be sure not to miss out since these special pet tackle boxes are dropping for only [b]1 month[/b]. Tackle boxes drop every 2 days, so while playing the game actively, you can grow your pet collection by a substantial amount!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/71b06266d4a64d95599e01f37e6cbbe2aa9df34b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/ce990bf6bc83060dd7b7153d939332d2707392fa.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/d61eed2590bf4ee63f9fd688abccdba6c07c35c7.png"][/img]

[/p][h1]Engine Upgraded to UE5[/h1][p]
Speaking of our ability to move forward, we have now migrated the engine to UE5 to keep up with dependencies that we need to continue developing the game. Re-enabling anti-cheat would not have been feasible without this time-consuming migration. For those who are also developers, don't worry – we have disabled all the new rendering technologies that usually drag UE5 performance down, so you should expect similar performance with the game after updating.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/a478e7ad0cd7c4082d1893a8bdd0266b082a3d3a.png"][/img]

[h3]Anti-Cheat Re-enabled[/h3]
We have now been able to re-enable Easy Anti Cheat since we updated our engine to a newer version. For me, it's baffling to think that an engine version that was only 3 years old is no longer supported by plugin developers, but the big work is now done and we hope this will reduce the number of hackers in the game by at least some amount by having an anti-cheat solution.

[h3]Modding Support[/h3]

Unfortunately, we did not manage to get modding support back working in time for this update, but we continue working on getting modding support back in as soon as possible. Meanwhile, you can still play 1.0 as a beta branch so you can still enjoy the modded experience!

Hey all, This small update consists of;

As we await upcoming bug fixes and updates, I'd like to propose a [b]quarterly server[/b] wipe cycle for discussion. Under this model, the server would reset every three months—four times annually—creating a balanced gameplay rhythm throughout the year.

To clarify the server would be separate from the rest. Tagged as for example: ([b]3MONTHLY Server[/b]).

Our community has been deliberating on the optimal wipe frequency that would maintain player engagement while still providing adequate time for meaningful progression. A three-month cycle potentially offers the best of both worlds: enough time to establish bases, and form alliances, without the stagnation that can occur with longer periods.

What are your thoughts on this quarterly approach? Would this timeline strike the right balance between refreshing gameplay and allowing for substantial accomplishment?

Please let us hear your thoughts on Discord.

notes.title: Devlog #54
notes.content:
[h1]April Recap and New Plans for Moving Forward[/h1]

Hi everyone! Hopefully you are having a great spring! I'm going straight to the point about what today's devlog is all about. We want to keep you updated on what is happening behind the scenes and what will be happening next.

[h2]Cheaters[/h2]

We are very aware of and share your frustration with cheaters, and we want to solve this issue as well. We have decided to add an anti-cheat solution back into the game, but before we can do that, we need to upgrade our engine version. This is not a small task but a necessary one to bring Longvinter forward and make it last for another 4 years. This upgrade will also enable us to add DLSS and the newest FSR upscalers to our game so we can have better image quality for low-end systems. We will be implementing this shift in update 1.1.

[h2]Update 1.1[/h2]

We have now confirmed that the next update will feature pets you can have while traveling the Longvinter island. We will be sharing more about pets later, but here is a little sneak peek at what our artists have been working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/d6af6bc6dfb146ab53fdac37d6a879c3fd4fe6e0.png[/img]

[h2]Leveling System for Items[/h2]

We have also been planning to add a completely new feature to the game in the form of item levels! Levels would affect items' values, and the higher the level, the better the item would be. For example, a level 1 Assault Rifle does only 3 damage, a level 5 Assault Rifle does 4 damage, and a level 10 does 5 damage. We are still working out the details and specifics of this system, but we want to hear your thoughts about it!

Comment to the post or let us hear your thoughts on Longvinter's Discord!

[url=discord.gg/longvinter][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/0a2fb37b2550d3b56ee37245ca251d042eab4a36.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Last 2 Weeks to Earn Tackle Boxes[/h2]

We also want to announce that tackle box drops will stop on May 23rd in preparation for the next one, so now is your last chance to earn tackle boxes.

notes.title: Devlog #53
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it's time for our Friday devlog, although this is more like a Saturday devlog now, but let's keep the name the same! In this devlog, I'll explain in depth the current situation with crashes and what we're going to do about it.

[h2]Why all the lag & Crashes?[/h2]

During launch, we saw an enormous amount of players and broke our previous all-time high player count by twofold. We had experience running highly populated servers in Korea, which is why we thought our servers could handle it, but they were still slowing down too much, more than we had anticipated. 

The main problem causing the servers to slow down was the way Unreal Engine handles replication (how the server decides what information to send to each player). The server CPU had to calculate the distance between every placeable and item that players had placed to all players, and figure out if they were close enough that the player needed to be sent that information. Our servers could have over 100,000 placed items, and when we had 80 players, for example, the calculations became so heavy that servers couldn't handle it effectively.

We found a couple of solutions and decided to try the "replication graph" method, which does the same thing as before but divides the map into a grid and performs calculations based on which grid the player is in. This solved the performance problem, and now all servers are running at least 10 ticks (calculations) per second. Unfortunately, the plugin that implements replicationgraph has some compatibility issues causing frequent random crashes. We managed to make it slightly better, but we're now in a situation where servers usually stay online for only about 3-4 hours.

[h2]What next?[/h2]

I want to first apologize for the state the game is currently in. We acknowledge that a fully released game should not be in this condition. We will be doing a few things to resolve the issue:

1. We're trying to solve the crashes by fixing how Unreal Engine handles "bad" actors that are no longer in memory, which currently causes the crashes.

2. If we don't manage to fix it by next Wednesday, we'll revert to the old replication method and try alternative approaches until we have a stable 10-tick rate minimum and at least 12 hours of uptime on servers.

3. After this, we'll start focusing on all the bugs and issues which cause item and progression loss, as this is the most frustrating thing when playing in a persistent world where all items are hard to get.

On the bright side, our artists are working on new content updates currently planned for June and another in august with the next official server wipe. More information on these will come in next Friday's devlogs!

Thank you for your support, and again, apologies for the current state of the game.

- Sven

notes.title: Longvinter 1.0 Is Out Now!
notes.content:
After 3 years of game development, growing as company, bug fixes and community suggestions and engagement, Longvinter has now been released with the 1.0 Update. I am personally out of words to describe how great it feels to have finished the game of this scale and even though it is still rough around the edges, it's definitely ready and feature complete. Now let's go over what has changed and what will be next for Longvinter!

[previewyoutube=LRcu-stJ994;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's Happening Next?[/h2]
As this episode of Longvinter's phase comes to an end, naturally a new one begins, and I know you will have quite a lot of new content to dig through this time. We will be focusing on making the game work great on Steam Deck with refined controller support on all the menus and also fixing bugs that come up with the new update. We also want to keep the performance at its best from here on out.

For our next big feature update, we already teased this but it is now confirmed that we will have [b]Longvinter Farming[/b] coming as "1.1" version of the game. We have also planned a big overhaul to new player experience and introducing renting apartments and shared communities. More info on these coming later so as always stay tuned for more!

[h2]PlayStation Release Coming in 2026[/h2]
I am also excited to announce that the game will be releasing on PlayStation next year! The game will provide cross-play options so we don't have two separate player bases limiting player numbers. 

[h2]New Tackle Catalog: Long Winter[/h2]
Naturally when we didn't include any new catalog and tackle box last Christmas, it's now time to introduce a new set of winter clothing in style of the game's name. This is our biggest one yet, and we have some unique features like changing ski colors on backpacks and unique decals on mouth pieces. While this time there are no new effects, these items can drop with all of your favorite effects from the past!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/d141536c0e963d9e05a2b94216ef6f522cf1378b.png[/img]

[h2]1.0 Update Main Features[/h2]
We wanted the 1.0 update to change something major in the game to really make it feel different for those who have played during Early Access. For that, we implemented new Points of Interest - Oil Rigs, which are large structures with significant verticality, quite challenging to design with our top-down game approach. Since this is our 1.0 update, we wanted to improve every aspect of the game, and we're really happy with how this update turned out. We have almost 100 new items with various mechanics. Let's start with the biggest change - the Oil Reworks.

[h2]Oil Rigs[/h2]
If you visit Sgt. Lake now, you may notice that fuel prices have increased quite significantly since your last visit. That's because the LRI have set up oil rigs around the Longvinter archipelago and are now controlling prices everywhere. You must take destiny into your own hands and process and steal your own fuel while under attack from LRI mercenaries. These new locations are super fun for both PVP and PVE players, and we're excited to see what you like most about them! With the addition of fuel refining, we've added Crude Oil as a new item that needs to be refined before turning into fuel. We've also added a new upgrade tree to the mining rig building - instead of crushing rocks, you can now pump oil yourself and use refineries to bring your own product to the economy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/c2c54e5d1ba037c736971801ecd347a00f8d5f5e.png[/img]

[h2]Heli Crash and Underground Arena[/h2]
Keeping in style of adding new interesting events, we have now added a heli crash to the map that lets you access new tactical gear that LRI use to try and hunt you down. We also have a new arena that invites all players every hour to fight to the last man in order to access the best loot right below Sgt. Lake base camp.

[h2]New Animals and Mounts[/h2]
Our map now has much greater variety in animals with the introduction of Lynx, Wolf, Wolverine, Fox, Moose and Goats now wandering in Longvinter Island. All of the new animals are also obtainable as mounts, and we have made the saddles unequippable so you can style your mounts as you like it best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/9e6e6a01ea3ad6a7429d91f163734642ae4a041d.png[/img]

[h2]Wildlife Improvements and Map Additions[/h2]
New small birds have now been included in all parts of the map that bring the island alive with their amusing looks and ability to always escape you no matter how hard you try to catch them. With this amazing new atmospheric addition, we have also added new roads to help starting players travel around first outposts more easily. Vendor catalogs have been upgraded with many new items, and we've improved many other things visually and brought more animations to everything to make the world feel more alive and immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/300476f8c4e108a9aa56408869c365b70eddd5b5.png[/img]

[h2]New Equipment & Items[/h2]
We've added several new equipment options to enhance your gameplay:

[list]
[*]4 new buff hats:
[list]
[*]Permanent movement speed
[*]Better item prices
[*]Cheaper travel costs
[*]Chance for double loot
[/list]
[*]Combat vests with special abilities:
[list]
[*]Hotkey eating from inventory
[*]Quick reload
[*]Weapon switching without inventory
[/list]
[*]Heavy sniper rifle (20 base damage)
[*]Hunters Amulet
[*]New explosives (C-4, Dynamite)
[*]Craftable sulfur and gunpowder
[*]New meals for cooking compendium
[/list]
  
[h2]New Placeable Health System[/h2]
We wanted to give placeable health more thought since it was previously a bit of an afterthought. Now we're really happy with new mechanics we have in place. You can see every placeable's health when hovering over them in inventory and while they're placed down. When you first place an item on the ground, they initially start with 31 HP and start gaining their health slowly. If a placeable takes damage, it will stop regenerating HP. If the placeable is damaged recently, it cannot be picked up, and if destroyed by shooting while not at full health, it will not drop an item. These changes will make using normal fences in combat less practical and encourage usage of sandbags that are catered for combat situations.

[h2]New Placeable Items[/h2]
[list]
[*]10 New Paintings to level up your house decorations
[*]Boat house to store your boats on water bases
[*]New Marksman Defender turret with longer range and damage
[*]New Machine Gun Defender that you can control for devastating fire power
[*]Electricity Pole to distribute electricity between your neighborhood easily
[*]New Firework with smiley face
[*]Oil refinery to turn crude oil into fuel
[*]Refrigerator and microwave to decorate your home with functional items
[*]New Metallic box building blocks
[*]New Rugs to decorate your home
[*]Home Harmony placeable set with lamps, plants, tables and cabinets
[*]New ramp to easily access water bases if you fall off your boat
[/list]
  
[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made house upgrade transitions smoother
[*]Added ability to undo item additions to vendors instead of dismantling the entire vendor
[*]Cabin roofs can now be painted
[*]Added option to disable pickup notifications
[*]Added UI indicator for house area locations to help players navigate between houses and avoid turret fire
[*]Added new good weapon chest to bunkers and mines
[*]Grid size adjustable with mouse wheel while placing
[*]Equipment now goes inside backpack on death instead of dropping on ground
[*]Players limited to 1 house in safe zone building areas
[*]Electrical placeables now drop if there's nothing below them
[*]Optimized server start time
[*]Most placeables now drop items instead of being destroyed
[*]Fuel can now be stolen from generators
[*]Custom map markers can be added and shared with other players
[*]Added more travel points
[*]First spawn location randomized instead of tied to Steam ID
[*]Shop shelves can't be stacked and require spacing between them
[*]Added slight delay before safe zone effect applies to prevent safe zone abuse
[*]Houses built on water have larger building area
[*]Auto-run speed now matches normal running speed
[*]Optimized cooking and crafting book opening times
[*]Improved Vintershop purchase reliability
[*]Players can now exit shops from any location inside
[*]Shops require clear pathways without placeables
[*]Turrets now have 30-second charging period after placement
[*]Added stacks to new items
[*]Snow health drain reduced by 50%
[*]Placeables that take over 30 damage in 10 seconds can't be picked up for 120 seconds
[*]Added placeable health display in inventory and on hover
[*]Added AFK indicator (Zzz bubble)
[*]Day cycle duration doubled
[*]Cosmetic toggle now includes custom backpacks
[*]Air drops now have plane sound effects and map markers
[*]Post-travel immortality period added to prevent spawn camping
[*]Items can't be placed in front of tents to prevent abuse
[*]Increased bunker loot
[*]Rain provides fishing buff to all players
[*]Fishing possible in any water, with spots still providing best results
[*]Improved AI shooting behaviour
[/list]

[h2]Weapon Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chainsaw: Fire rate 200 → 190
[*] Electric pickaxe: Fire rate 300 → 275, movement speed matched to chainsaw
[*] Auto Shotgun: Ammo/shot 12 → 6, scatter 4 → 3.5, fire rate 150 → 175
[*] Semi Auto Pistol: Damage 7 → 8
[*] Full Auto Pistol: Fire rate 260 → 320
[*] Submachine Gun: Fire rate 300 → 350
[*] Machine Gun: Fire rate 450 → 475
[*] Shotgun: Scatter 4.5 → 3
[*] Sawed Off Shotgun: Scatter 7 → 6
[*] Grenade: Damage 30 → 50
[*] Machete: Damage 4 → 5
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/6e487595587637735e2adad5c9c78a2b543f5b25.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #52
notes.content:
[h1]Final Early Access Devlog[/h1]

We're approaching a significant milestone as this will be our last devlog while the game is in Early Access. We want to express our deepest gratitude to all our players who have helped shape Longvinter into what it has become.

[h2]1.0 Wipe and Update Schedule[/h2]
We're excited to announce that 1.0 will be releasing [b]next Friday, February 21st, at 9AM UTC[/b]. All official servers will undergo a wipe immediately after the update goes live. We recommend unofficial servers to also perform a wipe if they experience any issues post-update.

We've finalized our wipe policy for official servers, implementing a 6-month wipe cycle (excluding monthly wipe servers). We believe this strikes the best balance between players who enjoy fresh starts and those who prefer persistent gameplay. To improve transparency, we've added a next wipe date display in the main menu while playing. This feature aims to prevent any unexpected surprises and keep our players informed about upcoming wipes. We want to remind everyone that hosting your own server allows you to maintain control over your saves and wipe schedule.

[h2]1.0 Experimental Recap[/h2]
The new update has been thoroughly tested in our experimental branch, where our community has been instrumental in reporting issues. We've already addressed over 100 reported problems and are working to resolve all remaining issues before next Friday's release. From experience, we understand that some bugs may slip through to the stable version despite extensive testing, but we'll be working throughout the launch weekend to ensure the smoothest experience possible.

[h2]Steam Deck Compatibility[/h2]
We're pleased to announce that with the 1.0 update, Longvinter will be fully playable on Steam Deck running the latest software version, with no workarounds required. We've verified this functionality on our own Steam Deck.

[h2]Prestige After Launch[/h2]
We've received numerous inquiries about prestige retention after the 1.0 update. While we're aware that some players have achieved prestige levels through exploits, we've decided to preserve all prestige progress out of respect for those who earned it legitimately. We believe prestige represents a significant achievement for honest players, and we don't want to diminish their accomplishments. However, we want to remind everyone that the upcoming wipe will clear all Mk currency, so if you're planning to purchase prestige, we recommend doing so before next week's update.

[h2]Server Population Cap[/h2]
After pushing our server capabilities to their limits, we've determined that a 100-player cap provides the optimal balance between performance and gameplay experience. This decision allows us to maintain server stability while still delivering an engaging multiplayer environment.

[h2]Looking Forward[/h2]
We want to assure our community that reaching 1.0 is not the end of Longvinter's journey. Our development will continue, and we're excited to announce our future plans soon!

notes.title: Devlog #51
notes.content:
Happy New Year and welcome to this year's first devlog!

We're more excited than ever as the experimental version of the 1.0 update is nearly ready for public testing, and we can't wait to share what we've been developing over the past 6 months. Experimental patch notes and discussions will take place in our Discord server, so be sure to join and get yourself an "[b]experimental-tester[/b]" role to be notified when the update is ready for testing. While experimental patch notes will be shared in Discord, the final notes will be available here when the game launches with wipe and the update goes live on all servers on February 21, 2025. 

Click Channels & Roles to select your roles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/2f6c23606cdb55d0203fc58353172896737bc857.png[/img]

We've moved the release date three days earlier to Friday (instead of Monday) to give everyone time to play during the weekend. The 1.0 update will remain in an experimental state for almost a month, giving us enough time to polish it into what we're proud to call a fully released game.

Let's go over some of the changes we've been working on:

[h2]Placeable Health Changes[/h2]
We wanted to make raiding during active gameplay a more viable option. Since placeable health has been somewhat of an afterthought, we've now given it the polish required to enable fun [b]raiding gameplay[/b]. Changes primarily affect building under fire - in 1.0, placed items will start with only 30 HP and slowly regenerate to full health after placement. Additionally, recently damaged items cannot be picked up and replaced, and items that haven't fully regenerated their health won't drop as bags when destroyed, preventing players from repeatedly using the same items as cover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/55ecdfcdaea53f69a473eb56c57d8d0eadc13921.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/24823ab04a53289fcb21d6e2ee2d54758c3ee017.png[/img]

[h2]Bullet Sync Issues[/h2]
We've addressed an ongoing issue where bullets visible on your screen weren't hitting their displayed locations. This "lag" occurred because bullets began their journey before reaching the server, which was intended to provide instant feedback. Without delving too deeply into technical details, we've implemented server-side lag compensation, resulting in much more responsive shooting mechanics. We've recorded comparison videos showing this issue in the current beta 1.14 build versus the new lag-compensated bullets in the 1.0 build. While other players' bullets may occasionally appear to spawn slightly after their gun barrel, we believe this trade-off is worthwhile for improved accuracy when leading shots.

[previewyoutube=cD39HtZaqZw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Dances Coming in Tackle Box[/h2]
On a lighter note, we're excited to showcase a new dance animation that will be available in the release tackle box!

[previewyoutube=lM4uOj2azK8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #50
notes.content:
[h1]Friday Devlog[/h1]

Greetings everyone, and a warm welcome to new players who have just picked up the game in the autumn sale!

It's a great time to start exploring Longvinter island, and we've been hard at work as always on the big 1.0 update that is coming next year in February, which will improve and touch on nearly every aspect of the game. 

[h2]Server Population Update[/h2]

We experimented with 200 player servers, and KR 1 saw a whopping 170 players at its maximum peak, which is really huge for us to see, as we never imagined a server with that many players. However, we've decided to reduce its capacity to 110 to maintain a better tickrate. Players on this server should now have a much smoother experience after this change.

[h2]VPN Checker Issue[/h2]

We've noticed some issues with the VPN checker making false positive kicks on private servers. We'll be providing an update next week to resolve this issue. In the meantime, if you can't connect to your own hosted server and it says you're using a VPN, please bear with us.

[h2]New Features Coming in 1.0[/h2]

[h3]New Mounts and Saddles[/h3]
We've separated mounts and their saddles into different items. You can now attach a saddle to any mount you like best. Saddles increase the mount's movement speed, making them a valuable addition!

[previewyoutube=zvb-mfdQTj8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Ambient Wildlife[/h3]
To make the world feel more alive, we've added small birds that can be seen flying in different places or just chilling on rocks and bushes in the 1.0 update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/300476f8c4e108a9aa56408869c365b70eddd5b5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/29af946940c1f2b61c5431b37aa5e630c671a8ef.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/c3659bf9c1d4e8d2da16f6268bfe408b976baebb.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/0aa320a7e5c6b3f24dc6e6d0356ae4c991d300d3.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Deck Temporary Solution[/h2]

Until we find a more permanent solution for the Steam Deck issue, the community has found a workaround you can use to play Longvinter again today.

Longvinter on Steam Deck, for compatibility reasons, works only with OS version 3.5.19 and not the latest one. If you wish to play Longvinter on Steam Deck, please downgrade your OS to [b]3.5.19[/b]. There are guides on the web that teach you how to do this.

Thank you for your continued support and patience. We're excited to bring you these updates and improvements!

notes.content:
[h1]Wipe Results and Server Update[/h1]

The poll results for server wipes are finally in, and we have some important information to share with you all.

[h2]Wipe Decision[/h2]

Based on the poll results, all regions except Asia have expressed a desire to wipe their servers. However, we've made some additional decisions to ensure the best gameplay experience for all:

[list]
[*]PVP Servers: All PVP servers will be wiped as requested by the majority of players.
[*]PVE Servers: We've decided not to wipe most PVE servers, as base building is more enjoyable with abundant resources.
[*]Asia Servers: Despite the poll results, we will be wiping some Asia servers due to stability issues caused by the high volume of placed objects.
[/list]
[h2]Reasoning Behind Our Decisions[/h2]

We didn't initially distinguish between PVP and PVE servers in our poll, but we've made an educated decision based on player feedback and gameplay patterns. PVP players generally seem more eager for a fresh start.

For Asia servers, the sheer amount of placed objects is causing instability issues with the Unreal Engine. We've selected specific servers that are unlikely to run stably until the global wipe in February.

notes.title: Devlog #49
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Hope you all have been able to get a chance at catching and getting back at the clown that has been causing mayhem in the server by stealing items. We have exciting news for you all. Longvinter now has a release date for its 1.0 update, and we also have a question about wipes that we want to ask opinions about.

[h2]Release Date for 1.0 Update[/h2]

We have decided not to rush the update since we have so many new things planned for it, and we want to make it meaningful enough for all players who have already played Longvinter to try it out again and return to play. This is why we have decided to launch the 1.0 update next year on the same date that we originally launched in early access, which is [b]February 24, 2025[/b]! This update will come with a wipe since we have made substantial changes to the economy of the fuel, and then everyone will get a chance to experience Longvinter as we would have wanted it to be experienced 3 years ago!

We are aware of Steam Deck issues, but currently, we cannot reproduce the problem on our own deck, which has slowed down the troubleshooting greatly. We will look into it more next week and try to figure out what's wrong with it! Sorry for the issue taking so long to resolve.

[h2]Should We Wipe Before Christmas?[/h2]

Many players in our Discord have been asking about the wipe day, and we're considering the possibility of a wipe before next year, given that the full release is still quite far off. We want to hear from you! We'll be creating a survey soon where you can voice your opinion on whether you'd prefer a wipe at the start of December or to continue playing without interruption until the full release.

Importantly, we'll be gathering opinions from each region individually. For example, if the Asia region wants a wipe but the EU region doesn't, we'll only wipe the Asia servers in December. This approach allows us to cater to the preferences of different player communities.

We encourage you to participate in the upcoming survey to help us make this decision. In the meantime, feel free to share your thoughts on wipes in general in the comments below. Your feedback is crucial in shaping the Longvinter experience for everyone!

[h2]New Vests and Dropping Items![/h2]

Here are the most recent updates our team has been working on:

[previewyoutube=dU6oLCOw-Q4;full][/previewyoutube]
We have finally made it so that placeables and items drop to the ground and don't stay floating in the air after there is nothing underneath them. This honestly should have been added last year already, but better late than never. We will make this an optional server setting behaviour so builders in PVE can still use their creativity, but for our official PVP servers, this will come as the default option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/80131198de5af6dc8615d1ed67888970d7ca2b3d.png[/img]
We have just finished modeling the 3 different combat vests that will be in-game items. The image shows one of the 3 color variants we have prepared for each vest so you can trade the one you like with your neighbor. These will enable a hotkey action that makes actions in your inventory without the need for opening it:

[list]
[*]Reload Vest: Reloads ammo from your inventory to your weapon by just pressing the hotkey.
[*]Weapon Vest: Allows you to change weapons in your inventory quickly by just pressing the hotkey.
[*]Food Pouch: When pressed, allows you to eat food in your inventory quickly.
[/list]

These are all focused on combat, and we believe these will give you interesting choices in what to use in combat and make your style shine with a vest that embraces it.

Thank you, and see you all on Longvinter Island!

notes.title: Devlog #48
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It's been a while since our last devlog, so let's catch up on what the team has been working on. With summer vacations wrapping up for our employees, we're back in full swing, building the next update. We also released a trailer for a new game, which is super exciting! We'd like to clarify some things people have been discussing, so let's dive in.

[h1]New Update Taking Shape[/h1]

The new oil rig environments are starting to look ready, although they're still missing some new props. We wanted these areas to have puzzles and enemy NPCs like the mines, so they've taken quite a lot of time for 3D modeling and level design. Here's an update video showcasing one of the three new oil rig locations we're cooking up:

[previewyoutube=ilfgg-JlnSQ;full][Update video][/previewyoutube]

We're also preparing to add three vests you can wear in the game. These will give you quick access to certain items in your inventory without opening it. For example, we're planning a reload vest that lets you reload by just pressing an action button, automatically loading ammo from your inventory into your weapon.

For those wondering, the next update will come with a wipe because we're making big changes to fuel and want the economy on servers to start fresh with these new changes.

[h1]Autumn Tackle Box[/h1]

We're still figuring out how to get everything ready before the next update. We're considering limiting the autumn tackle box to a small collection of items or possibly skipping the box for now and focusing on adding things to a future update.

[h1]Longvinter Leaving Early Access[/h1]

That's right! Some of you may have put two and two together and realized that as we prepare to launch a new game, we're also finally leaving Early Access. We know the game isn't bug-free, but we've achieved a lot with server performance. The game is in a completely different state compared to when we first launched.

The game's various mechanics, items, and systems working together have created an environment where small changes can break things in unexpected places. This has been a big project for our small team, but we've learned a lot. We'll continue ironing out issues and bring you the most stable Longvinter experience yet with the full release.

There are still problems with containers not spawning after server restarts, but we've been steadily fixing issues and will continue to do so in the future. We haven't wiped the servers in almost three months, so some problems are just now showing up since we haven't run servers without a wipe for this long.

[h1]What's After Early Access?[/h1]

We've already planned at least two more content updates for the game after the official launch, so don't worry – there will be plenty of new things to experience on Longvinter island! We've completed all the features we made public in our first roadmap last year, and we'll continue developing new content.

After oil rigs, new mounts, and animals are in the game, we're planning a full farming update with a new buildable barn and tameable animals. We're excited to share more info when we have the details ready. We also want to add more endgame content for our dedicated players who speedrun the game's compendium and other features.

We're reading your suggestions on Discord and adding suitable ideas to our progress tracker for future implementation. There's sometimes a big time frame between adding a suggestion and deciding whether to include it in a future update, but we read all of them and will continue to do so. Keep the suggestions coming!

Thank you, and see you all on Longvinter island!

notes.title: Devlog #47
notes.content:
Hi all. It's been a while since our last update, but we wanted to share what the team has been working on. Despite some team members taking summer vacations at different times, work has continued steadily.

[h2]New update is in the works[/h2]

We're thrilled with the server performance improvements achieved in the 1.14 update. Seeing 150 players simultaneously on the KR 5 server was a remarkable milestone, surpassing the goal of 100-player servers that we set when we launched in Early Access.

[h3]Currently, we're focusing on two major aspects:[/h3]

1. A new environment that will completely rework how fuel is obtained in the game. We'll share more details once we have things more polished.

2. Reworking the mount system and adding 5 new animals that can be obtained as mounts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/35b4581331b5a0a03097cd496bee13a38a58596a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/2ed903ade35351c8dad1e00558518ee6799975a0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/bf10e29f5e62b148cab48d935d67097ea03a027d.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Deck issues[/h2]

We sincerely apologize to players using Steam Decks who have been unable to log in to the game due to an EAC error. Rest assured, we are actively working on a fix and will update you as soon as the issue is resolved. Thank you for your patience.

[h2]Prestige issues[/h2]

If you upgraded your prestige and want to move over to another server, there is currently a bug in the game that prevents you from obtaining the upgrade on another server. You can easily fix this by deleting your preferences save file, which causes prestige to be resynced with your device, fixing the problem.

Go to [b]C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Longvinter\Saved\SaveGames[/b] and delete the preferences.sav file. Then, when you log back into the game, it should give you the prestige.

[h2]Introducing the hardcore server[/h2]

We've been planning a new server concept that offers a unique Longvinter experience, tailored for players seeking a more challenging and rewarding gameplay. This dedicated server will accommodate up to 200 players, depending on performance.

The hardcore server is designed for players who enjoy a more punishing and intense playstyle. Here are the currently proposed "rule" changes for the hardcore server (subject to change):

[list]
[*] No code locks on houses or tents
[*] Turrets can be destroyed
[*] Players drop half their currency on death
[*] Weapons deal double damage
[*] Energy drain from walking reduced by 80%
[*] Loot respawns 2x faster
[/list]

We'd love to hear your thoughts on this new server idea in the comments below!

[*] Prestiges are now separated to have individual PVP and PVE levels. Levels obtained before the change will keep their level regardless of whether it was obtained in PVP or PVE servers
[*] You can now buy a decay upgrade from LRI station for individual homes. Upgrade doubles the wood and decay time for the selected house
[*] Shop Upgrade: Location broadcaster that allows players with map and satellite communicator to see shops on the map that have the upgrade
[*] Advanced workbench now has a built-in crafting book
[*] Some better cooking stations now also have a built-in cooking book
[*] Chests now have Take all / Store all buttons
[*] Miniturrets can now target NPC and vice versa
[*] You can now whisper to other users in global chat that you have seen previously on the server
[*] General Vendor items are now sorted from lowest to highest price by default. Due to technical limitations, we cannot provide a full search of the items like in other places
[*] You can now see team members' online status on the team page
[*] You can now kick players who are offline from the team
[*] New eating and cooking animation added
[*] Autorun is now disabled with WASD movement to prevent players from accidentally getting stuck in autorun
[*] Increased house building block vertical size
[*] If a player disconnects during travel, the player is now spawned at the destination
[*] Official server daily restarts will now have a message warning for players to react to daily restarts
[*] Default backpack and large backpack now have new models
[*] Fixed issues with widescreen monitors where you could not interact with the universal vault in LRI stations with a widescreen aspect ratio
[*] Zoom scaling also adjusted for different aspect ratios to make all aspect ratios see as much of the game
[*] Hat special effects are now always shown on top of the hats, even if you have a gameplay hat ON like Hunting hat
[/list]

[h2]UI/UX Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cooked Bird meat now has a distinct icon separating it from non-cooked
[*] Added more cursor colors (Yellow, Pink, and Turquoise)
[*] Adjusted LRI Station vault UI to better match the available space inside the vault. You now open 10 slots instead of 8 and increased the upgrade cost by 1000 Mk to reflect this change
[*] You can now toggle a setting to always show just visual hats instead of gameplay hats in general settings
[*] You can now inspect hats and other equipment by clicking them in the character customization screen
[*] Added icons to the main menu to show when you can earn in-game drops
[*] Event tabs now have loading indicators to prevent confusion when loading is taking a while
[*] Event score should now be correctly updated to the scoreboard upon visiting the scoreboard item in-game
[*] Applied a fix for Japanese characters that should now look mostly normal
[*] Gesture Wheel:
[*] You can now do gestures by pressing G by default and selecting a move
[*] All players are given 6 gestures by default to fill out the wheel. More gestures will be released later
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/c40fe8e238dd77f5f881115f2dc48bd1ad38ada2.png[/img]

[h2]Stackable Items:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made most of the flowers, ore chunks, and wood stackable in inventory
[*] Any item that can be eaten cannot be stackable for balance reasons
[*] Stack sizes can change in the future depending on how the balance changes with this change
[*] First house cabin upgrade wood requirements have increased from 100 wood to 150 wood and 50 juniper wood separate to balance the now much easier wood carrying. Players can now carry 100 wood in inventory, so they should be spending less time walking back to the house and more time harvesting wood

[/list]
[h2]Vendor Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Julia's Mystery vendor now buys items from players at 2x the previous rate to really make it worth it to try to sell items to her
[*] Shipments now give 3x better rewards than previously
[*] Pristine and regular antlers and wolf tooth prices increased around 1.5x
[*] Cooking NPC food prices increased around 10% and he now sells Salt, Pepper & Dill
[*] Increased black lotus price
[*] Increased ore and ingot prices
[*] Balanced other high-moving item prices to match their value
[/list]

[h2]Map Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hunting compendium island (Padva) now has a shooting range where you can compete to see who fires the targets fastest. Beating the high score earns you 5000 Mk
[*] Compendium hat buyer who exchanges hats for mysterious bags and for other hats added to the map
[*] Doubled the number of animal spawns in the winter regions to make it more profitable to hunt there
[/list]

[h2]Weapon Balance Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] After reviewing player suggestions and usage data, we have decided to make the following changes to weapons:
[*] Assault rifle fire rate increased from 450 → 475
[*] Lowered chainsaw movement speed while "Firing"
[*] Lowered Semi-Auto Pistol damage from 10 -> 7 and increased fire rate from 260 → 300
[*] Made Modern rifle more accurate by reducing its scatter from 3 → 2
[*] Modern Burst Rifle damage increased from 6 → 7 and projectile speed from 260 → 300
[*] Lowered Auto Shotgun bullet scatter from 5 → 4
[*] Buffed Machine gun damage from 6 → 7 and fire rate from 420 → 450
[*] Mines/bunker combat buff no longer disappears
[*] Made some rocks non minenable
[*] Fixed teleport camera transitions
[*] Player save is no longer reloaded if it already exists on the server
[*] Team details update should now make a new team for player that was kicked offline
[*] Fixed sauna collisions
[*] Added a second fix for the disconnect issues that was caused by new gesture wheel
[/list]

[h2]New Summer Catalog [/h2]

Together with the Summer Catalog comes the Summer tackleboxes! You will be receiving these tackleboxes if you play actively every 48 Hours. So the tackleboxes have a 48 hour cooldown with the drops! We've also made an UI element to show if you're able to receive a tacklebox or not.

You're able to receive the tackleboxes during: [b]27.06 Thursday -  29.07 Monday[/b]
After that you are no longer able to receive these summer tackleboxes. 

The Summer Catalog Shop will be opening later today! In Approx. [b]6-8Hours[/b]. You can still receive tackleboxes right away! 

See you on the Isles! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/77a376bfabca3490056ef430de60b1a4590ca0b8.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #46
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It has been a while since our latest update. We have been busy working to get 1.14 ready with its quality-of-life changes and some new features as well!

[h2]1.14 and a wipe on June 27th[/h2]

We have made a rework to the saving system after identifying a cause that led to crashes on the servers. We have moved all the saving code to be up to date with the best practices that we have learned over 2 years. Unfortunately, this requires a full wipe when moving from 1.13 to 1.14. We are confident that the update will be ready on [b]June 27th[/b], and all official servers will [b]wipe on that day[/b].

1.14 also includes a weapon rebalance that sees a big nerf to the most popular Semi-Automatic Pistol that has dominated the kill feed for the last 2 months. More rare and expensive weapons will receive buffs, which hopefully makes using them worth the risk of losing.

[h2]Building Contest[/h2]

In the meantime, while waiting for 1.14, we are announcing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1635450/view/6534240634786443754]second building contest[/url], now with different brackets for modded and vanilla versions so you can really go crazy with customization. Also, the full painting features added in 1.13 will help you get the colors of your yard just right.

Keep a look at our experimental channel in our Discord for updates on the experimental build. We will be announcing there when 1.14 is open for testing with full patch notes.

notes.title: Devlog #45
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 🙋‍♀️🙋‍♂️

Spring has been starting super slow here in Finland, and we just received a fresh coat of snow here in Helsinki. But time goes forward nonetheless, and we have just finished the feature list for 1.14. Those can be read on our [url=https://trello.com/b/Ixvlmrle/longvinter-roadmap]roadmap on Trello[/url]. We will be updating the progress on those in real-time so you know when to expect the new update.

[h2]Last week for tackle boxes[/h2]

Spring tackle boxes have been dropping now for over a month. We have decided to stop the drops for the tackle boxes in a week, so you will have until [b]May 6th[/b] to get tackle boxes from playing the game. We will be increasing the drop window for tackle boxes from a 2-day cooldown to a 1-day cooldown. For the rest of the month and the first week of next month, you can get a tackle box by [b]logging in every day[/b]!

[h2]1.14 feature list[/h2]

As we discussed in an earlier devlog, we now focus more on quality of life and gameplay-related changes, not new features. I would like to highlight a couple of things here, but the full list of planned changes can be read on our [url=https://trello.com/b/Ixvlmrle/longvinter-roadmap]Trello page[/url].

[list]
[*] Decay time increase
We want to allow players to keep their houses for longer with minimal maintenance. For this, we plan to add a new upgrade to the LRI stations where you can buy an upgrade that extends your house decay time for another week. We feel that since servers have quite a lot of room for houses now, and introducing motors to boats has shrunk the size and made areas more accessible, we can allow players to keep their houses for longer.

[*] Normal stones can be broken with a pickaxe
This will be a small change but allows many more options to build your house.

[*] More dice games
We plan to have more dice games finally implemented, and we would love to hear your suggestions on simple but engaging table games that can be played with dice to be implemented.
[/list]

[h2]EU server reset and KR1 placeable data loss[/h2]

Unfortunately, we had a couple of incidents with the servers where errors filled up the drives of the machine unexpectedly. This resulted in the server not saving items on the server correctly or not at all. We have taken measures to clear up the server files that take too much space, and we have acquired a new backup server where we will be backing up all the saves periodically so we have the saves on at least 2 machines at all times.

Thank you for reading and come say hi to us in [url=https://discord.gg/longvinter][b]Discord[/b][/url]!

notes.content:
[b]Hello! [/b]🐰

Missed the Easter event? Still feeling hoppy? 🐇 For a limited time only, hop into the [b]in-game cosmetic store[/b] 🛍️ and grab your very own bunny hat! 🎩 Don't miss out on this bouncy opportunity!

Here's your chance to support the developers and look adorably bunny-ish at the same time! 

[h2]Update details[/h2]

Here's the updated devlog with the changes wrapped in the Steam list format:

[h3]Update on mining rig and boat attachments[/h3]

We felt like the mining rig was not up to our standards and wanted to give it more love in the style of a new information screen that explains to you in detail how much your mining rig is producing! We also made changes to how the ores drop and where you place it makes an impact. Each of the regions in the game, for example, grass, autumn, spring, and snow, have different possible ores that are included in the yields that can be mined.


[b]Boats[/b] now also have 3 new items that can be attached to them with an advanced workbench:

[*] Fixed bug on steam inventory where keys would show up as duplicate
[*] Fixed an item duplication exploit when placing item

notes.title: Devlog #44
notes.content:
Good Friday to everyone! 😊

It's been so nice seeing many of you trying out the new update and coming back to the game. I hope you have enjoyed your time on the Longvinter island. If you haven't tried the new update yet, you can still play [b]this weekend[/b] and get an Easter bunny drop. The drops will stop on Monday, so this is your last chance!

[b]What is coming moving forward[/b]

The next major update ([b]1.14[/b]) will not focus on adding any new major features but rather on refining and fixing the current game to a much better state. 
We have prioritized adding new things over fixing existing issues because we didn't want to fix everything only for it to break again after the next update. However, we now feel that it's a good moment to pause for a second and thoroughly go through all aspects of the game to make changes that will improve it. But don't worry, we will be planning and creating new assets constantly to have a big update after 1.14! 

Update 1.14 will also have some new features that can be easily implemented but have a big impact. We will go over these in more detail in the [b]coming Friday Devlogs[/b].

The launch of the 1.13 update went [i]pretty smoothly[/i], but there have been quite a number of issues that were found. Here is a small recap of all the bug fixes we have done after the 1.13 update:

[list]
[*] Fixed the spring tackle box drop table missing some items
[*] Fixed a bug where picking up a shop shelf made it a normal vending machine
[*] Fixed a bug where PVE server players could not open storage boxes that had no house near them
[*] Attempted to fix the violent rubber band movement of boats
[*] Filemon outpost now gives the correct 5Mk for wood instead of 0
[*] New face cosmetic items now have correct icons for female variants
[*] Added an image cache feature for Steam items that will make loading the Steam inventory in-game much faster
[*] The Farming Compendium quest can now be completed again
[*] Improved the character customization screen to not load everything at once to prevent crashing issues
[*] Fixed a shop having a wrong item in the sale tab
[*] Campfires in snow areas now give enough energy to heal over the snow energy drain
[*] Upgrading the LRI station global inventory now takes the correct amount of Mk from the player
[*] Fixed the Farming Compendium not being able to be completed
[*] Adjusted fireweed rotation
[*] Fixed a bug where shop vendors become normal vendors after server restart
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Prestige upgrades to not work on the first upgrade
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the container UI to remain open and unable to be closed
[*] Resolved an issue where players were unable to exit the house after aiming, requiring a server restart to fix
[*] Corrected a bug that prevented female faces from being properly selected on the character edit screen
[*] Added a clarifying note to the scoreboard, indicating that scores will be added to the leaderboard upon logging off
[*] Implemented a new script that synchronizes the stated team score with your leaderboard score (please note that you must log off for the score to be saved)
[*] Fixed an issue where entering the mining rig could teleport the player back to the dock, and also fixed an issue where upgrading a house could teleport the player back to Sgt. Lake
[*] Resolved a bug that caused ingots in the smelter to keep refilling after server restarts
[*] Addressed an exploit where vendors incorrectly gave score for both buying and selling (now, only selling counts towards the score, and the item must cost at least 100 Mk to be eligible; stacks of cash no longer contribute to the score; players who have gained unusually high scores using this exploit will have their scores reset for this month)
[*] Players who are not allowed in a home will now be teleported out to prevent tent abuse
[*] Fixed a bug where the mining rig would stop working after it had filled once
[*] Reduced the effectiveness of fishing spots in safe zones to encourage players to explore different spots outside of safe zones
[*] Reduced the score gained from fishing by 66% to better balance it with other activities
[*] Fixed the /kill timer, which should now work as intended
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to duplicate signs
[*] Fixed an issue where the Painting Station would not return items when the player moved away
[*] Fixed an infinite coal bug with the smelter
[*] Fixed a bug where the Team bubble would appear randomly
[*] Fixed a bug where the Large Dinghy showed building blocked areas even when it could be placed in them
[*] Improved the smoothness of the joining process
[*] Added another fix to boat physics (attachment replication is still broken)
[*] Added missing swimming sounds
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to open the cooking interface while using the workbench
[*] Increased the maximum price increase that players can set for vendors from 500% to 800%
[*] Increased the prices for water canister, mystery bag, salt, black pepper, and tarp to better match their usefulness in the game
[*] Added a new banning method
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from inserting items into the global vault from player shops
[*] Implemented a 30-second cooldown for placing tents at the start of the game to prevent abuse
[*] Resolved an issue where the Market, Mining Rig, and Windmill would teleport players back to the dock upon entering (players should now be able to enter these structures correctly)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.13
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that [b]Update 1.13[/b] is just around the corner! We will be updating all the official servers to version 1.13 today at 12PM. This update includes a [b]full server reset[/b] for the official servers to provide a fresh, exciting experience for everyone.

😊 Check out the trailer video! 

[previewyoutube=_w3IK6_s5qU;full][/previewyoutube]

Alongside the update, we're kicking off the [b]Easter Loot Event[/b]! 🐰🥚 From [b]March 27th to April 8th[/b]. Play the game during the event period, and you'll receive one piece of the [b]Easter Bunny outfit[/b]! This is the perfect opportunity to hop into action, show off your skills, and earn some festive gear. 

📅[b] Event Details:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Update Rollout[/b]: March 27th, 12 PM
[*][b]Easter Loot Event[/b]: March 27th - April 8th
[*][b]Reward[/b]: One piece of the Easter Bunny outfit for participating
[/list]Update Rollout: March 27th, 12 PM

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/b25cefaf948eebef38e7d811f2722bc6e2e86f51.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/b86c171a4b6ad95df97ab26cc9e2768e16c6f38a.png[/img][/url]

Please note that the server reset means a fresh start for all players on the official servers. We believe this will provide a fair and enjoyable experience for everyone, aligning with the new features and improvements coming with Update 1.13.

We're incredibly excited for you to experience everything we have in store and can't wait to see you all in-game sporting your Easter Bunny outfits! Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm.

Happy gaming, and see you on the servers!

🐣 [b]Uuvana Team [/b]🐣

[h2]New features[/h2]

[list]
[*]Option to toggle Q-hold view change in general settings.
[*]Introduced a prestige system for resetting compendium, money, and progression for additional house slots. Prestige stays with the player on other servers and is not reset when the server is wiped.
[*]Added more paths to upgrading the tent. It can now be upgraded to a shop, mining rig, or water mill that have unique benefits but can be raided, so beware. You are also required to have at least 1 cabin before upgrading to others.
[*]Improved Electrical panel functionality: View all electricity devices and set high priority for devices requiring stable electricity.
[*]Spring Biome introduced on the west side islands, featuring new flowers.
[*]Added Roaming NPC that collects items found on the map and trades them for Mk.
[*]House upgrades that don't change the house shape can now be uninstalled, note that resources are not gained back.
[*]Added ammo, sauna, and greenhouse sell limits to general vendors to prevent abuse of item duplication.
[*]Added 4 new quests, introducing players to new elements and challenges in this update.
[/list]

[h2]New Items[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/58bf4223c4980492be6657b3eefc76f718ea7455.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/ed2ec399bff4e663f04d5bd4f243c38a1557947c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/059d7583fdaa6b3512c43247d25e08f2c2e2dc5d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/32603ef24f5d0a424416232ac5f2e2aa1db07787.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/d0d07e29e86b50f217f214c8523bd057d266aaca.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/3ae89071dab8a0dfd953c7bd52104a78f47da825.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Weapon attachments: laser sights, spread reducers, heavy barrels, and receiver upgrades. You can attach weapon attachments using an advanced workbench.
[*]Introduced Painting station: All placeables can now be painted using paint items at the painting station.
[*]Added 7 new paint items.
[*]Battery item in-game now has a charge level that can be charged up in the Battery Charging Station. You can put full batteries in the Battery Backup Station that provides electricity to your house if the power requirements are not met.
[*]New mini turret added that uses batteries to power up when not near any house. This can be destroyed by shooting. If near a house, it uses the house's electricity instead of a battery.
[*]Cooking compendium vendor now sells a cooking hat that increases your cooking speed.
[*]Cooking outfit is now given when the player gets the cooking compendium completed.
[*]Added a treasure map.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added new fishing spots around the lighthouse.
[*]Maximum team size capped at 12 players.
[*]Removed cooked trout from the Vendo-O machine in the lighthouse.
[*]Ingots pay out now 2x more.
[*]Increased grenade throwing animations and projectile speeds by approximately 30%.
[*]Turrets have doubled downtime if disabled and reactivated within 30 sec.
[*]Melee damage against players doubled.
[*]Eating the same type of food multiple times now causes you to get less energy from that. However, if the food type is "other," it's excluded from this debuff to encourage cooking more complex recipes.
[*]Score can now be gained from chopping wood, mining rocks, cooking, and selling items to regular non-player placed vendors.
[*]Changed visual style of ping value of server while playing. Also added a server performance indicator.
[*]New swimming and hatchet animations.
[*]Raised Global inventory unlock price since the LRI stations are now more freely available.
[*]Adjusted backpack sizes to be roughly the same size as the starting backpack.
[/list]

[h2]Weapon balance changes[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/643c509c2106d1d3af3c9ac0f310bec0432ce33a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/ae13c20a88ee4ae776115dc08b6538b20ca1ec55.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Reduced semi-auto fire rate by 30%.
[*]Reduced sawed-off shotgun projectiles from 9 to 8.
[*]Reduced semi-auto pistol accuracy by 25%.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Team scores now persist when switching teams.
[*]Admin panel button hidden for non-admin players.
[*]Chat messages limited to 160 characters.
[*]Getting ping to server caused a lot of lag when the server was highly populated. Made a new method of getting the ping that does not cause lagging.
[*]Fireplace healing is now capped to 4 concurrent to bring maximum healing effect to prevent overhealing.
[/list]

[h2]Monthly scoreboard and new dynamic events[/h2]

To make playing more fun, we have added a new twist to the score system we built for servers. All your achieved scores will be counted on a [b]global leaderboard[/b] where the best players are rewarded with custom hats every month!

We also added a second type of event where you need to do certain actions like fishing, cooking, farming, or mining, etc. Your actions are counted towards the goal, and if you do enough, you earn [b]vintercoins[/b], and the best players are also rewarded with a custom hat with a special effect.

[h2]PVE Adjustments[/h2]

[list]
[*]Turrets no longer engage players since they can't do damage.
[*]Plants cannot be picked up.
[*]Chests cannot be opened on other players' yards.
[*]Greenhouse cannot be entered if you don't own it.
[*]Weather station cannot be stolen from.
[/list]

[h2]New Spring Catalog[/h2]

[list]
[*]In-game shop now has updated items and much-requested female outfits to buy and wear.
[*]Added new tackle box to drop table and new key to the shop.
[*]Spring Tackle box contains over 10 new cosmetic items that can also be purchased from the shop but with limited color choices.
[*]Spring hats have 4 new possible particle effects that they can spawn with.
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/ce8e4ac471950897a2b3775da6274003e1c599e8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/ee5d062c1f1a1a4e273366da9b9bed91b664e68e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/6a005fba48998500f27d4c72a74d48e4c42df478.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/a941297d4f2d06cfa0e754dd3f1b193f7456117d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #43
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Spring is really starting to make its presence felt, and our new update, 1.13, has been in the works for a couple of months already. We've decided to set the release date for next week, so let’s dive right into the details.

[h1]Wipe & Update on March 27 at 10 AM UTC[/h1]

We've scheduled the game update for next Wednesday. The reason for a mid-week update is to ensure the update is live well before the Easter holidays. This timing gives us the next full day to address the most critical issues that may arise with the update. Additionally, we're excited to introduce new cosmetics and possibly even a new tackle box filled with Spring-themed items!

This update significantly reworks the building system, and as a result, we will be wiping progress on all official servers. We strongly recommend that unofficial servers do the same. This means all houses, placeables, and player progress will be reset, and everyone will start fresh, similar to servers that have "Monthly Wipe" in their name.

You can already get a sneak peek of the new update in our experimental build. Here's a guide on how to get involved:

Please use our Discords channel's [b]🧪-experimental-longvinter[/b] channel to report bugs and talk about the update!

[url=https://discord.gg/longvinter][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/0a2fb37b2550d3b56ee37245ca251d042eab4a36.png[/img][/url]

To access the experimental servers go to Steam -> Library -> Right click Longvinter -> Properties-> Betas -> set experimental-public 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/38ebf27d7cebbc13d54ada584a6d2e63b7e21494.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #42
notes.content:
Welcome to our latest devlog! This week, we've been hard at work planning for the upcoming 1.13 update, and we're thrilled to share that the key features are now finalized and ready to go into development!

[h1]What's New in 1.13[/h1]

[h2]Customization[/h2]

We're excited to build upon the new item system introduced in the 1.12 update. This system offers us greater flexibility in game code, and we're ready to leverage its full potential in the next update, starting with boat customization. You'll soon be able to personalize your dinghies, equip them with motors and storage boxes, and even color them in one of seven unique shades!

We're also working on customizable weapon attachments, which will alter your weapon's handling, damage, spread, bullet velocity, and laser aiming.

Moreover, we're introducing a coloring station where you can use paints (also a new addition in the upcoming update) to [b]color all new placeable items[/b] in seven vibrant hues currently offered partially in the Allotment garden set. Here are the colors we have planned: White, Charcoal, Blue, Red, Yellow, Mint, and Blush.

[h2]New House Upgrades[/h2]

We're also eager to expand the upgrade options for the new cabin. The planned upgrades will provide players with more advantages than just an ordinary cabin, but won't include code lock protection, making all stored items vulnerable to raids by other players. This is part of our strategy to balance gameplay between those who enjoy raiding and those who prefer the existing system. All new upgrades will necessitate at least one cabin placed on the map before other structures can be added.

[b]Water Mill [/b]- A water-based upgrade featuring a waterwheel for power generation and storage. (Raidable)

[b]Storefront/Trading Post[/b] - An extension of the vending machine offering more role-play and player engagement opportunities. This upgrade will also come with an overhaul of the cooking system, introducing status effects for complex recipes. (Not raidable)

[b]Gallery [/b]- An accessible building where players can display their prized trophies and items. (Raidable)

[b]Mining Rig[/b] - Extract ores from the ground. (Raidable)

[h2]Spring Biome[/h2]

As we approach summer, we're also bringing Spring to Longvinter Island in the next update. Spring will introduce its own art style, a new wood type, and a unique flower to the biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/51393b145bb229ea8318ed470889f5b930d631b9.png[/img]

[h2]Check out Trello for More Updates [/h2]

For more details on the planned features for 1.13, please visit our roadmap on Trello: https://trello.com/b/Ixvlmrle/longvinter-roadmap


[h2]Map Making Program [/h2]

Last week we announced the launch of modding for all players, and now we're introducing a custom map making program! You'll be able to create your own map and submit it for inclusion in the game. Detailed instructions for creating custom maps and the criteria for their acceptance can be found in our [url=https://github.com/Uuvana-Studios/longvinter-modding/blob/main/MapCreation.md]Map Tutorial[/url]. Remember, the program [b]does not have a deadline[/b], so you can submit your creations at your leisure once it launches.

We will be posting the custom map submission link to our Discord channel's [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/longvinter]🔧-modding channel[/url][/b] together with details what to submit.

For any discussions, queries or brainstorming sessions with fellow modders and developers, head over to our Discord server at [url=https://discord.com/invite/longvinter]https://discord.com/invite/longvinter[/url]. You can find us in the 🔧-modding channel.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/longvinter][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/0a2fb37b2550d3b56ee37245ca251d042eab4a36.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Christmas Update & Sale
notes.content:
[b]Christmas Update[/b]

Season's greetings to all! Longvinter is currently available at a whopping [b]50% [/b]discount during the Steam Winter Sale. This is our most substantial discount ever, and we want to express our gratitude for your incredible support throughout the past year. We are thrilled to announce that there will be new updates and features coming in the next year.

During the festive season, you can purchase Christmas decorations from shops located near each major port, specifically, [b]Diogo's Dock, Kyrres Base Camp[/b], and [b]Sgt. Lake Outpost[/b]. Additionally, you can find Christmas gifts near various Points of Interest.

We've introduced a fun new feature - a throwable snowball! Enjoy spirited snowball fights with friends. We've also added a placeable item that shoots fireworks, perfect for ringing in the New Year.

We've also squashed a few more bugs. Here's a list of the latest fixes:

[list]
[*]Resolved an issue where hat effects did not reset after disconnecting during combat.
[*]Corrected a bug where cooking a complete meal repeatedly no longer contributes to compendium progress.
[*]Fixed issues with entering and exiting various buildings.
[*]Apple trees can now be destroyed by attacking them.
[*]The flying candy effect is no longer transparent.
[*]Resolved numerous errors and warnings.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these updates and continue to support us in the coming year. Happy holidays!

notes.title: Gift Boxes & New Shop
notes.content:
[h2]Longvinter in Jingle Jam Charity[/h2]

First, I want to wish all of you a very good start to December. I have some exciting news to disclose. Firstly, Longvinter is participating in a charity event where you can donate to any charity and receive a collection of games, including Longvinter. All the money goes towards the charities. The link to the event is here: [[url=(https://jinglejam.tiltify.com/)]Jingle Jam Charity[/url]]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/9cc7572f95c4b646ec0f025aae3dfc8e0dc2fcf0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/7dd94bcec1258f15b99435c061e47716a77c4e94.png[/img][/url]

[h2]More Customization[/h2]

You've been asking for more customization options, and we're delivering. Going forward, you will receive compendium outfits for each type of compendium: Farming, Fishing, and Hunting. The Cooking outfit is still in production but will arrive after December. Once you've unlocked all items in a given compendium, the outfit will appear in your inventory, and you can equip it from the newly renamed 'Shop & Customize' screen in the menu.

We've also added custom backpacks, other clothing items, new faces, and hats. More details on how to achieve them in the next chapter.

[h2]New Item Shop & Vintercoins[/h2]

As mentioned earlier, there's now a new item shop accessible from the customize menu. 

Here, you can buy items to wear while adventuring on Longvinter Island. Vintercoins, a currency you can buy with your Steam wallet, are also introduced. Additionally, you'll earn 500 Vintercoins by playing about 30 minutes daily. Players who have previously played Longvinter can retroactively redeem Vintercoins based on their playtime. Note that your games library must be public to achieve this.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/2ed1a428734a337593a8e9672c1cb3298dcc9e08.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/9bb4ba9349df9b662c6648c67a0b5ddbb9bcc417.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/6a2f9a0db9b6bcf593ce598a6cfdd7d9cbb7d9e4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/6ea64482b7c1b0c7a387e8cf766caadd487a0f78.png[/img][/url]

Some items are only obtainable from tackle boxes, which drop randomly as you play. These can be opened with keys available in the shop, purchasable with Vintercoins – so no real-world money is needed to obtain and open tackle boxes.

[h1]Free Tackle Boxes[/h1]

Starting today, you'll also receive Christmas edition Tackle Boxes that don't require keys to open. Simply click on them in your inventory in character creation to open them!


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f64fadd0fba75b754559ef378f91d1fb666d43a6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/059b8aee470feae4d6b828a21530b6eb2022a87b.png[/img][/url]


[h2]1.12 Retrospective[/h2]

I want to take a moment to review the initial launch of the 1.12 update and address the issues experienced in the first week. This was the largest overhaul we've done since the game's initial launch, and it will be the last major overhaul of a singular system. The reason for the overhaul was to allow more customization of items and placeables. Now, each item can have unique values, so we don't need to create multiple instances of the same item with minor differences. We can also now store states, like a mini turret battery state, which persists even if you pick it up to relocate. Server lag issues are our top priority, and the item shop and customization shop were completed before we launched 1.12, even to the experimental branch.

Thank you for being patient, and we'll return next week with another bug fix update!

tags.feature: Going forward, you will receive compendium outfits for each type of compendium: Farming, Fishing, and Hunting.
The Cooking outfit is still in production but will arrive after December.
Once you've unlocked all items in a given compendium, the outfit will appear in your inventory, and you can equip it from the newly renamed 'Shop & Customize' screen in the menu.
We've also added custom backpacks, other clothing items, new faces, and hats.
As mentioned earlier, there's now a new item shop accessible from the customize menu.
Vintercoins, a currency you can buy with your Steam wallet, are also introduced.
Additionally, you'll earn 500 Vintercoins by playing about 30 minutes daily.
Players who have previously played Longvinter can retroactively redeem Vintercoins based on their playtime.

notes.title: 1.12 Cooking Update
notes.content:
I hope you all are enjoying a wonderful autumn. We are extremely excited to hear your thoughts on the new cooking system and the many other changes I'm about to present. Additionally, we have prepared a video detailing these changes, which you can watch below.

[previewyoutube=xm5trvzz8DM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Item System[/h2]

The reason for the necessary wipe in this update was due to the complete overhaul of the item system. This new system allows our items to have unique properties while they are in the inventory. It enables dynamic foods, which are included in this update, and paves the way for exciting future additions such as weapon attachments, paints for placeables, and battery-powered turrets. Additionally, this update should eliminate most duplication issues, as every item now has a unique ID that tracks its origin.

[h2]New Cooking System:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Meals now require a category of item rather than something specific
[*]The Cooking Book contains a list of craftable items and essential recipes
[*]Some hidden recipes are learnable only by studying a Cooking Recipe

[list]
[*]If an ingredient imparts an effect or buff, it is transferred to the finished dish. Note: A dish can only hold one effect or buff at a time
[*]Consumption of another food with the same status effect is restricted until the current one expires
[*]Foods that provide more than 35 Energy initiate a cooldown period before subsequent consumption. This cooldown duration is proportional to the food's energy content, with an indicator displayed on the bottom left of your screen
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]New Items:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 12 new plant items and seeds to grow them
[*] 30 new dishes with various
[*]Binocular
[*]Sawed-off Shotgun
[*]Lumberjack Hat
[*]Heavy Combat Helmet
[*]Laser Rifle
[*]Guide Book with all new in-game tutorials
[/list]
[h2]New Challenge Island:[/h2]
A new island, located south of the map and featuring a boss NPC, has been added. Defeating this boss provides an opportunity to obtain the Heavy Combat Helmet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/4c99507ec37b6bb5cd5513cddec30b1ca34553fc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Resolved an issue preventing the "comeback achievement" from being attained
[*]Addressed the Greenhouse plant bug: Previously, when placing two different plant species in the greenhouse and harvesting when ready, the system would return only one type of plant.
[*]Added a maximum value of 100 000 MK cap for the Weather Machine
[*]Fixed a delay issue where solar panels with batteries took an extended time to establish an electrical connection
[*]Official servers can no longer be accessed via direct IP connection
[*]Eliminated duplicate entries of official servers in the server browser
[*]All trees placed in Heisala can now be chopped down without triggering safe zone turrets
[*]A bug causing hats and cosmetics to disappear upon login has been fixed
[*]An issue where the mouse would lose focus when opening the inventory, requiring an extra click to interact with items, has been resolved
[*]A bug where long pressing to sell all would not work has been fixed
[*]A bug where placing a boat between land and another boat in water would cause the boat to jump and glitch into the ground, allowing it to be used on land, has been resolved
[*]Fixed an issue allowing players to wear hats without completing the compendium
[*]Server Name Display on the main menu: Limited to 20 characters with "..." to prevent overflow
[*]Addressed an issue where servers would disappear from the server browser but remain playable
[*]Fixed a bug where containers attached to walls would disappear during house upgrades
[*]Fixed bugs in the dice game
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Enhanced the points of interest in the new islands with additional models and world-building
[*]Food energy values have been completely rebalanced to align with the new cooking system
[*]Introduced a Cooking Compendium
[*]News posts can now be accessed from the main menu
[*]Additional NPCs have been added to the map
[*]Implemented general settings for toggling OneFrameThreadLag
[*]Limited the number of player-placed fires to 8 per player
[*]Improved AI prediction of player movements and targeting accuracy
[*]Introduced a new quest to purchase turret kits from the plant vendor upon completing the plant compendium
[*]New tutorial windows have been implemented to clarify the game's mechanics
[*]The character creation process has been reworked to display your Steam items
[*]Hovering the mouse over player vendors now displays the number of listings
[*]A warning window has been added to the disconnect button when in Combat
[*]Right-clicking an item within a container or player inventory now drops it to the ground
[*]Walking footsteps sounds can now be adjusted in Sound settings
[*]The respawn time for NPCs has been increased
[*]AI sight has been expanded
[*]Ammo Management: Ammo now fills available space efficiently, with a selling rate adjusted to 20 mk per ammo
[*]Model Updates: Enhanced models for workbench, water pump, fireplace, sofa, modular cabinet, vendors, and team gate
[*]Weather machines in the map that generate Mk
[*]Doubled the amount of weapon and legendary loot in Krokon, Skabban, Kupmo, & Jumo points of interest
[*]Introduced more rare minerals to Repouuro Cave
[*]Increased the amount of ores provided by nodes by 25%
[*]Increased the base price of ores and ingots by 20%
[*]Grenades now require line of sight to apply full damage to placeables
[/list]
