notes.title: Devlog #40
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Welcome to today's devlog. Let's dive into the latest on our Halloween event and tease what’s in store for the next update!

[h2]Halloween Event[/h2]

[b]Time's ticking—this weekend is your last chance to join the Halloween Loot Hunt![/b]

It's been thrilling to see everyone in the game hunting for the new Halloween-themed items. The riddle we introduced has been a hit, and we love watching you all exchange tips and tricks to solve it. For those collecting pumpkin hats, you've probably noticed a 10% chance of snagging one with a cool particle effect. We're aware the blue pumpkin hat isn't showing its effect properly. No worries—if your steam inventory lists it as "with flame" or shows another effect, it'll be visible after our next patch. There's nothing you need to do on your end.

[h2]Roadmap Revisited[/h2]

Looking back at this year, we've checked off nearly all the goals on our roadmap since our 2022 launch. Yet, we're far from done with content updates. With a wellspring of new ideas and gameplay enhancements, we're eager to continue evolving the game as we journey through Early Access. Your suggestions on Discord spark even more creativity for future features! Coming next year, we're revamping the tent upgrade system, adding more customization to firearms, and introducing new paint options for your placeables. Take a glance at the updated roadmap and join the conversation about the updates you're most excited about.

[url=https://trello.com/b/Ixvlmrle/longvinter-roadmap][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/544247e43efb52ffd32b0652905b19e59ea7d1b7.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Progression Wipe Alert – November 21[/h2]

Big changes are coming with the next update, requiring a full reset of inventories and gear. To align with the launch of update 1.12, all official servers will undergo a progression wipe on November 21. While unofficial servers aren't obligated to wipe, we recommend it for the best experience. Wipes are rare but necessary for significant updates. Don't worry, though; you can enjoy uninterrupted gameplay on official servers for several months post-update. We appreciate your understanding.

[h2]Update 1.12 Sneak Peek[/h2]

Our team has been diligently crafting update 1.12, and we're stoked to share that it will roll out in the experimental branch next week, right after the Halloween festivities wrap up. Get ready for a culinary revolution with over 30 new recipes and a completely dynamic cooking system! You can throw in any ingredients you like to whip up a dish, with the energy value varying based on your choices—for instance, swordfish in your soup will pack more punch than perch. We've also mixed in jams and other treats that offer various buffs, and now you can combine them with any food to customize your adventuring boosts. We can't wait to see your top dish selections and how you plan to gear up for exploration.

[h2]New In-Game Hats[/h2]

Plus, we're thrilled to unveil two new in-game hats: the Woodcutter Hat and the brand-new Ballistic Helmet. We're setting up a mini-raid where you'll have the chance to conquer a boss and snag that helmet. And here’s a little sneak peek with a screenshot of the new raid island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/4c99507ec37b6bb5cd5513cddec30b1ca34553fc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 1.11 Halloween update
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added 10 new cosmetic items to the game that can be earned by playing the game during the Halloween event. Note that some rewards must be discovered from the game level to unlock them.
[*]Map now has Halloween decorations
[*]Optimized player turrets to not be as CPU intensive on the server side
[*]Mining helmet can now be bought from the vendor in Sgt. Lake base camp
[*]Electric pickaxe can now be found in weapon chests
[*]Trees can now spawn a maximum of 7 wood & 2 resin when chopped
[/list]

[h2]Weapon balance changes[/h2]
[h3]Semi-automatic, Submachine gun and chainsaw are the most popular weapons with 85% of all kills made by these 3 weapons. With this update, we wanted to tune down these a bit and make other 
weapons more serious options.[/h3]

[list]
[*]Semi-automatic
[list]
[*]Semi-auto has been the most popular weapon by a long shot due to its easy acquisition compared to other weapons and its constant damage output. We wanted to emphasize its role as Marskman weapon with the following changes:
[*]Increased the damage from 9 → 12
[*]Reduced fire rate by 33%
[/list]
[*]Chainsaw
[list]
[*]While we want to keep the relevance of a melee weapon in the game we thought that chainsaw was a bit too good. We wanted to lower movement speed to prevent chasing but changed the fire rate/damage ratio to keep it more constant
[*]Lowered movement speed while “firing” by 10%
[*]Increased fire rate by 100%
[*]Decreased damage from 16 → 7
[/list]
[*]Submachine gun
[list]
[*]The submachine gun was also trendy and the global average kill distance was so short that it seems obvious why submachine gun and chainsaw both dominated the place for most used weapon. We wanted to keep its relevancy as the top close combat weapon but we felt like its 1,5-second TTK was too little to allow an opponent to react when shot
[*]Reduced fire rate by 25%
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Some other weapons were really lacking in damage or fire rate department and we wanted to raise some weapons stats to be better at their intended role[/h3]
[list]
[*]Crossbow
[list]
[*]Crossbow was when introduced intended to be an easy to acquire hunting and combat tool. The current damage was just not cutting it in combat or when hunting and we wanted to give it a serious damage buff to make it shine. Although it will still be a bit lacking with projectile speed and reload speed this should give it more roles as a finisher or when playing in a group and bursting down enemies
[*]Increased damage from 10 → 30
[/list]
[*]Shotgun
[list]
[*]The shotgun is also another early-game weapon really just lacks damage and we wanted to give a little damage boost to make it more in line with other weapons and allow you to do more than just hunting with it
[*]Increased pellet damage from 3.33 → 4 (Note that the shotgun shoots 6 pellets so total single-shot damage is now 20)
[/list]
[*]Auto shotgun
[list]
[*]Automatic shotgun was always meant to be really deadly in close to mid-range but it really did not live up to its intended purpose. Here are the changes we are making to the weapon in order to make it compete with submachine gun as the ultimate close combat weapon that uses more ammo and is not as versatile
[*]Increased pellet damage from 2.5 → 3.5(This shotgun has also 6 pellets per shot)
[*]Increased the ammo consumption/shot from 6 to 12
[list]
[*]To make it more punishing to miss your shot and to make this a premium option
[/list]
[*]Damage fall of increased by 400%
[list]
[*]This ensures the intended role as a close combat weapon
[/list]
[*]Increased fire rate by 50%
[list]
[*]Makes the time to kill in line with the submachine gun[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.11 is finally here!
notes.content:
We introduce to you Update 1.11, a collection of features that we hope will bring joy and freshness to your gaming journey. 

We've been hard at work, and while we can't help but feel proud of what we've created, we approach this announcement with a sense of humility and gratitude for your continued support. 

[h1]Major new features[/h1]

Let's delve into the highlights of this update: Check out the update video below!

[previewyoutube=V3VwImOTzSc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]⛏️Caves[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f07b0fcf3614799a8a43c748dd95c64bdd9ccc81.png[/img]

Caves are a new randomly generated environment added to the Longvinter island! Along with Caves we are introducing Mining and Smelting! New ores that players can gather and smelt into ingots to craft items and new placeables. Mines also contain new facilities where a player needs to complete a challenge in order to gain access to the [b]best loot[/b] in the game! 

[h2]Wolves[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/fb66b040a7545c07d22c80620c1bb85b72e93ecd.png[/img]

Wolfs can now be found on the map and killed for valuables. You also need to collect wolf items to complete the hunting compendium. 

[h3]🐺Mount Up with Wolf Mounts[/h3]

Wolfs can now also be mounted and used to travel faster across the island! [b]To obtain a wolf you have get a collar first[/b]. This can be obtained by doing the compendium tasks eg. fishing, farming and hunting. The chance of dropping one is really small but when you get one, you can exchange it to the mount with each of the compendium vendors. 

Once you have equipped the wolf, you cannot lose it to death.

[h2]⚙️ Equipment Tab Rework: A Fresh Look and Feel[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/13bdf4c2731eee326376d8cdbb16bb6039ef1716.png[/img]

The equipment tab gained some love after a long time of feeling really unpolished and placeholder. We added a live preview of your character and reorganized all the icons!

[h2]New items[/h2]
[list]
[*]3 types of mining equipment
[*]Mining hat
[*]Metal fence(5 variants)
[*]Metal gate(5 variants)
[*]Metal chair (5 variants)
[*]Metal garden planter (5 variants)
[*]Metal garden table (5 variants)
[*]Metal garden firepit (5 variants)
[*]Garden chair
[*]Papasan chair (6 variants)
[*]Coal Smelter
[*]3 different collars
[*]12 different mounts
[*]Wolf meat
[*]Wolf tooth
[*]Wolf pelt
[*]2 new fish
[*]3 new mushrooms
[*] 6 new ores and their ingots
[*]Grenade
[*]Football

notes.title: Devlog #37
notes.content:
[i][b]PSA[/b]: Due to technical limitations, we had to limit the number of frog hats given to 1 per device.[/i]

Greetings! The Steam Summer Sale has kicked off, and we're thrilled to invite all newcomers to the captivating Longvinter Island. There's already a wealth of content for you to delve into. Plus, we've created an opportunity for you to snag your own hat just by playing. For the explorers among you, try venturing across the expansive map to unearth the hidden frog hat. Remember, these special hats are available for a limited time, so don't miss out! 

In today's devlog, we'll be discussing what we aim to introduce and enhance in our next update. While we don't have a specific release date at the moment, we ask for your patience and promise it'll be worth the wait.

[h3]Caves[/h3]

Our primary focus recently has been developing a dynamic and engaging cave system. Designed to echo the established bunkers' mechanics, these new, randomly generated caves promise to add a fresh layer to your gameplay. They will pave the way for [b]mining[/b] mechanics, the discovery of various ores, and the introduction of [b]smelting[/b]. Alongside this, we're rolling out a unique garden set, craftable from multiple metals, allowing for distinctive aesthetic variations. To guide you through this expanded gameplay, we're introducing a dedicated quest line centered around the caves. Dive in and experience this exciting new chapter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/74b80f04b1a4f2501fec5a336ad3fb57973dbffe.png[/img]

[h3]Wolves Unleashed[/h3]

After several tantalizing hints and a six-month wait, we're thrilled to announce that wolves are finally joining the game! These new additions will form part of the hunting compendium, marking our first venture into hostile wildlife. We're eager to see how you'll engage in combat with these creatures. But that's not all - these wolves aren't just foes, but also potential allies. You'll be able to use them as [b]mounts[/b] for faster land travel. Stay tuned for details on how you can obtain one of these beasts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/3c3d2e2e3b8d0efba44150bb4b63a77ddfe1b64e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/5cb6bb4c99bee8d3178294edf7c8a3f4432dd287.png[/img]

[h3]Additional Features Preview[/h3]

In addition to the major features we've been sharing, we've got a host of other enhancements planned for you. These include the ability to name containers and sort items within them for easier inventory management. We're also reworking the equipment tab for a more user-friendly interface that offers a better view of your character. New elements such as a [b]passive fishing[/b] net/trap and more are on the horizon. As always, we'll roll out these updates first on our experimental server to ensure thorough testing and bug fixing before the broad release on other servers. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Devlog #35
notes.content:
Welcome to Friday Devlog!

[h2]Modding Support[/h2]

The final version of our modding support is now ready and we're planning to distribute it gradually through Google Forms submissions. Just [url=https://forms.gle/w6QsGAv6Hcz8jf5d9]fill out the form[/url] and we will give access to the GitHub repository.

[h3]What Can You Achieve with Modding?[/h3]

To begin, you'll need the source build Unreal Engine 4.26 to access the project editor. We've made specific elements modifiable by adding a "replaceable actor" component to the items you're permitted to modify. Here's an overview of what you can currently achieve with modding:

- Introduce new items to the game, such as food, plants, weapons, and additional placeable objects for your house
- Customize homes with varying appearances and colors, or upgrade turrets instead of electrical systems, and more
- Create new in-game events, like air drops
- Make alterations to Longvinter Island; while custom maps are not yet functional, you can still manipulate the map by spawning objects and executing server code
- Modify the player character by adjusting running speed, enabling a fully rotatable camera, and adding custom character models. Since we use the Unreal Engine's default mannequin character skeleton, you can easily introduce new models as player characters, as well as custom UI elements
- Replace chests to offer improved loot or increased quantities of existing loot

As someone who has spent countless hours modding games like Skyrim and Fallout, I'm thrilled to see what unique creations you'll produce with our modding tools. We'll review your ideas submitted through the forms and create guided tutorials for the most popular ones, helping you get started as quickly as possible! 

[url=https://forms.gle/w6QsGAv6Hcz8jf5d9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/9da4876bd6c208213f2c531ab2aa673e797c9fa9.png[/img][/url]

[h2]When is the next update arriving?[/h2]

Before we release the next major update, we'll first apply a hotfix to address the remaining issues and ensure that modding support functions smoothly. This will also resolve any critical bugs still present in the game. Following that, we'll start working on the forthcoming update, which will prioritize your feedback, implement quality of life enhancements, and incorporate your suggestions.

We've already begun developing features like customizable chest names and the ability to quickly sort items within chests by value, rarity, and category. Additionally, we'll be introducing the highly anticipated and previously postponed [b]hostile wolf[/b] to the game. As we finalize our objectives for this update, we'll share more details about the planned changes. Furthermore, we will continue to work on fixing bugs and incorporating the quality of life improvements you've recommended.

We appreciate the feedback and input from our players and are committed to providing the best possible gaming experience for all. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Devlog #34
notes.content:
Welcome to Friday Devlog!

[h3]Modding support[/h3]

We made every effort to have modding support ready for the launch of this update, but unfortunately, we couldn't complete all the desired features. We also didn't want to delay the update any further, as server progress was wiped due to update requirements. We saw that many players were eagerly awaiting the wipe more than the update itself. We apologize for the issues encountered at launch and are working diligently to address them. In the coming weeks, we'll be resolving the remaining significant issues and adding modding support. Let's also address some other concerns that have been raised. In the meantime, we encourage players to start preparing by installing the required [url=https://docs.unrealengine.com/4.26/en-US/ProductionPipelines/DevelopmentSetup/BuildingUnrealEngine/]source build of Unreal Engine 4.26[/url]. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we continue to work towards delivering the best possible gameplay experience for our community.


[h3]Currently known issues[/h3]

We've received reports of a bug that emerged since introducing controller support. This issue causes characters to halt their movement when eating or interacting with items in the inventory. We have already taken steps to mitigate this problem and will continue working to resolve all instances where it occurs.

Another significant concern you've shared is related to gun recoil while moving. In version 1.10b, we transitioned to a new character model using Unreal Engine's skeleton, simplifying the animation process. Previously, movement recoil was solely managed through animation. We decided to switch to a random spread calculation for better control over recoil. While we intend to maintain a slight accuracy reduction when moving to give retreating players a better chance of survival, we plan to adjust the recoil next week. We'll closely monitor your feedback and continue fine-tuning until we reach a satisfactory balance for all players.

[h3]Results of Player Survey on Official Server Wipes[/h3]

Recently, we conducted a survey to gather feedback from players on server wipes. We received 197 responses, and here are the key results regarding the server wipes:

[b]Do you want all official servers to have wipes?[/b]

Yes: 54.8%
No: 45.2%

[b]Would you rather have:[/b]

All official servers wiped: 38.1%
All PVP and monthly wipe servers wiped: 9.1%
All PVE and monthly wipe servers wiped: 16.2%
Only separate monthly wipe servers: 36.5%

[b]How often should the Normal servers be wiped?[/b]

Every month: 18.6%
Every 3 months: 41.5%
Every 6 months: 39.8%

After analyzing the results of the player survey, we are thinking about making some changes to our wipe policy. We would be keeping the Monthly wipe servers, which will reset every month, and we would be wiping the other official servers every 6 months.

We believe that this approach strikes a good balance between the desires of our player base and the need to maintain a stable and fair gaming environment. Players who enjoy the frequent reset of progress and the challenge of starting fresh can continue to play on the Monthly wipe servers, while those who prefer a longer-term experience can enjoy the other official servers.

We appreciate the feedback and input from our players and are committed to providing the best possible gaming experience for all. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Devlog #33
notes.content:
Welcome to Friday Devlog!

[h3]Scheduled Wipe and Update in Two Weeks[/h3]

The upcoming update will necessitate a complete wipe on official servers, as we plan to expand the available house building area and modify the number of houses a player can place. The scheduled update and wipe will take place on [b]April 13, 2023[/b].

[h3]Enhanced Modding Support and Update 1.10b[/h3]

Having addressed the most critical issues in version 1.10, our team has been diligently working to introduce modding support, server optimizations, and various quality of life improvements. Our goal is to enable servers with 50 players to maintain a minimum of 20 ticks per second. Although we haven't tested the newly optimized build yet, we are optimistic about its performance following the update. Additionally, we have refactored portions of the code to enhance security and reduce the risk of hacking.

[h3]Integration of AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution[/h3]

In our next update, we will be incorporating FSR support, significantly boosting frame rates for players who have struggled to achieve a stable 60 fps. FSR technology renders the game at a lower resolution before upscaling the image, making it compatible with all devices and a prime choice for implementation.

[h3]Update 1.10 Trailer[/h3]

For those who missed update 1.10, we invite you to watch our new trailer, which highlights the key new features.

[previewyoutube=P_vBGwoj04k;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Player Survey: Shape the Future of the Game[/h3]

We value your input on aspects such as wipe schedules and safe zones. For the next two weeks, we will be collecting responses via a Google form to better understand your priorities and guide our development efforts. We're eager to review your feedback, and we'll share the results with the community later on.

[b][url=https://forms.gle/hMNX32o5UBGNAT1o8]Answer to the survey here[/url][/b]

[h3]Steam Deck Compatibility[/h3]

We are pleased to announce that Valve has officially confirmed our game's compatibility with the Steam Deck. We welcome any feedback regarding the Deck's controls and potential improvements. As the game continues to evolve, we will address all identified issues in a later stage when it reaches a more complete state.

notes.title: Update 1.10 is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings! Welcome to update 1.10!

We have exciting updates and changes to share with you! From the highly requested controller support to the addition of new weapons, crafting items, and water platforms, we hope these updates will enhance your gaming experience and provide new challenges and opportunities for creativity. As always, thank you for your support and for being a part of the Longvinter community.

[h2]Controller support[/h2]

We've heard your requests for a more relaxed and comfortable gaming experience, and with this update, you'll have the option to play using a controller. We know that this feature is important to many of you, and we're excited to make it a reality.  Please be aware that this feature is still a work in progress and will require further improvements to be fully polished. Get ready to dive into the island with ease and comfort.

Known issue that came with controller support: Sometimes when you are moving and try to eat the character stops moving or changes running direction. We are working this issue.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

- Wooden boats should no longer teleport to other location if user jumps on it
- Boat physics are now tied to the frame rate so they will behave almost same if playing in 60 fps vs 10 fps
- Fixed the bug where lights would have massive blocks attach to them
- Players should less often teleport to Sgt. Lake base camp upon connection to server.
- Player will now receive error message if their network id is not set correctly and the server could not save their progression. Game restart should fix this issue
- Fixed a bug where snow / rain did not go away after raining ended
- Fixed a bug where you could teleport back to your boat by using ctrl + 1.
- Players can no longer shoot structures from the farming island Heisala
- Reworked some collisions on rocks to prevent players from getting stuck
- Prevent player from teleporting out of the bunkers when entering the bunker
- Fixed some warnings that popped up frequently in the server console

[h2]Changes[/h2]

- Player turrets can no longer deal damage to placeables
- Bonfire is not placeable near other bonfires
- /kill cooldown reduced to 5 minutes
- Code locks now have bigger cooldown to prevent users from brute forcing themselves to others houses
- Boats can now be destroyed with weapons
- Admins can now kick players from admin panel

[h3]Major changes to safe zones[/h3]

- Shooting inside the safe zone will trigger turret response instead of the aiming
- Players inside the safe zone cannot take damage from other players guns
- You cannot shoot your weapon for 2 seconds after leaving the safe zone to prevent peaking out from the safe zone and going back in

[h3]Server optimizations[/h3]

The screenshots below are from a empty servers, servers with many players still have some issues and we will continue to work on them.

[i]Old[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/745f33cb4578ff396f7e38e68cea6c66dde786c7.png[/img]

[i]New[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/2e8e4f92888794a7321b746ceb971c1d176c7500.png[/img]

[h2]Items[/h2]

[h3]Weapons and related[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/8b0d865fc1eb36a34a0ddd016b9f9484af020ce4.png[/img]

- Shooting Target, for those who enjoy target practice. Take aim and improve your marksmanship skills. 
- To go along with your new target practice item, we've added two new types of arrows
- Arrows [5]
- Arrows [10]
- Crossbow, to use these arrows which now has a maximum arrow count of 25.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/84fcbf7710ab07f671b1b8c1603d818480604c4d.png[/img]

- Auto Shotgun
- Auto Shotgun Kit

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/00dfb72e8742aedfd5d7ed67504cfa1df907327e.png[/img]

- Machine Gun, now increases ammo capacity by 100 when equipped.
- Machine Gun Kit

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f5bc2be63e2093d6740cf8b7f5ac08e24629a3c6.png[/img]

- Sandbags can now be placed in open terrain and near Points of Interest, to prevent griefing near vendors and other hub locations is not allowed (Decays in 5 minutes after placing).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/9b3d57c99d8d8a568199a1e2e4ae6a89d89b52ae.png[/img]

- Machete, new melee weapon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/c0cd610c8c5880625fe4e937f55f46c543de0ae6.png[/img]

- Electric Water Well fill empty bottles (will replace the vendor bottle switch).  Will help you stay hydrated in the harsh winter environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/6afdcd47dc8e184aff08a77196d1e73313ef6458.png[/img]

- Wooden Box
- Wooden Box With Steps
- Wide Wooden Box
- Wide Wooden Box With Steps
- Staircase Building Pieces

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/5d04f13ceae941a1241bd36c678dc7d5af2877e6.png[/img]

- Green House, simply place the Green House next to your home. Once powered up, it will automatically farm the plants you add to its inventory, making it easier and more efficient to gather resources. Get ready to take your farming game to the next level!
- Water Fountain

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f3aff7b4ae5e644f1989c2c79c4c7cf680e54240.png[/img]

[h3]Water platforms[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f48b146582b6f678b5159596967523619b9d71ef.png[/img]

We are thrilled to introduce the water platforms! With this new feature, you can expand your base into the water and create unique structures and designs. We can't wait to see what you'll create!

- Wooden Water Platform
- Wooden Water Fence
- Polymer Water Platform
- Polymer Water Fence
- Wooden Water Gate
- Polymer Water Gate

To prevent all bodies of water from filling from these platforms we have restricted the placement to the green zones that are visible when placing the platforms. Check out the areas where you can place these water platforms in the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/a60dc9baab688520546d42ba18826c1c875447a5.png[/img]

[h3]Crafting changes[/h3]

- Increased sofa crafting requirements
- Garden fence can now be crafted
- Wood stool can now be crafted
- Water sprinkler can now be crafted
- Planter box crafting requirements increased so it cannot be crafted with normal workbench
- Modular cabinet can now be crafted
- Small dinghy can now be crafted
- Satellite communicator can now be crafted
- Radio can now be crafted
- Change code locked gate to requirements

We've also added several new crafting items that will help you craft more advanced items.

- Electronic Motor 
- Polymer Composite
- Electric Circuit Board

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/75a305e64b7c49ebcabccfe7b3ed70ea2ab37463.png[/img]

- Advanced Workbench, enhancing the crafting system by requiring more components for certain items. It adds a new level of distinction between early and late-game items, using basic materials like wood and metal. This creates a more engaging and rewarding crafting experience, giving players a sense of progression as they advance through the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f6131896f685bd0b233794235f867cb8745dbba4.png[/img]

- Disassembly Machine, that allows you to disassemble weapons crafted with Long Gun Barrels to obtain necessary components. Be mindful that the machine requires electricity and there is a chance some components may be lost during the process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f76325b996ad5c71dec3bd44b2414cc5bdbc0ee4.png[/img]

[h3]Other[/h3]

- Global chat can now be accessed through the satellite communicator
- To round out the update, we've added a new quest - "Hermit of the mountain"

We would love to see your creative builds and designs! Don't hesitate to share your creations with us and the rest of the community. Whether it's an impressive base, or a unique item arrangement, we want to see it all. Share your screenshots and videos on our social media channels or Discord server. Your creations could inspire others and bring new ideas to the game.

notes.title: Devlog #31
notes.content:
Greetings! We are excited to introduce our new Community Manager, Arttu, who will be responsible for moderating forums and social media channels, responding to player feedback and complaints, organizing events, and acting as a liaison between the players and the development team. Arttu will also be involved in creating and executing marketing campaigns and strategies to promote the game and increase its player base.

[h3]Few words from the community manager[/h3]

Hey All! I am thrilled to announce that I have recently joined the team as the community manager! As a passionate gamer myself, I am excited to be a part of such an incredible project and to have the opportunity to interact with you all. As you may have already read, I am here to serve as the bridge between the development team and the player community. Your satisfaction is my top priority, and I am here to ensure that your voices are heard and that we can work together to make the game even better.

I am aware that there have been some issues with the servers and the game itself, but please know that we are doing everything we can to improve the overall experience for everyone. We are listening to your feedback and suggestions, and we are committed to making Longvinter the best game it can be.

See you on the island!

[h3]Korean placeable save loss[/h3]

We deeply apologize for the recent issue affecting some of our Korean servers, where some placeables are not being saved or loaded correctly. We understand the frustration and disappointment this has caused, especially for those who have lost progress as a result. We want to assure our players that we are actively investigating the root cause of this issue and working diligently to find a solution as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to resolve this matter and deliver a better gameplay experience for all of our players.

[h3]1.10 Progress udpate[/h3]

We have continued working on the upcoming 1.10 update that now includes significant server-side performance improvements, as well as a new queue system that ensures fair access for all players. However, before the update is ready for release, we need to conduct thorough testing to ensure a smooth and seamless experience for everyone. One of the challenges we are currently addressing is how to introduce the new water placeable platforms in a way that doesn't allow players filling all bodies of water with these platforms. We are considering restricting platform placement to specific areas, similar to how point of interest areas disallow other placeables. Following the 1.10 update, we will focus on resolving all bugs on our Github and optimizing and cleaning the code in preparation for the long-awaited modding support. Thank you for your patience and support as we work to deliver the best possible experience for our players. To keep the discussion organized, we encourage players to share their thoughts and report any bugs they encounter on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/longvinter][b]discord [/b][/url]channel "🧪-experimental-longvinter". By doing so, we can ensure that issues with the experimental build are properly addressed and separated from the stable version. We will also inform you about the new updates in this channel

See the image below on how to switch to the experimental version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/38ebf27d7cebbc13d54ada584a6d2e63b7e21494.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #30
notes.content:
Greetings! The team has been working hard to bring you the next big update for Longvinter. I am thrilled to share all the exciting new content and improvements with you. But before we dive into the details, let's take a moment to address some concerns and questions that have been raised by some of our players about our company and the game. Stay tuned for an update that promises to bring even more fun and adventure to Longvinter!

[h3]Uuvana and other projects[/h3]

We understand that some of our players may have come across information about an additional project we have been working on in addition to Longvinter. While we are proud of the progress we have made on Longvinter, we recognize that we are a growing company and our capabilities extend beyond just one game.

That being said, our focus remains on addressing the lag and saving issues in Longvinter, and we will not even think about moving away from Longvinter until these problems have been resolved. We are grateful for the community's support and understanding, and we appreciate all the feedback and suggestions we have received thus far.

Going forward, we will continue delivering new content and updates to Longvinter, and we are always open to considering ideas and suggestions from our players. Thank you for your support, and we look forward to bringing you more updates in the future.

[h3]Modding support delayed[/h3]

Unfortunately, we have to delay the modding support until the 1.10b update. This is due to the increasing issue of hacking in our servers, and we need to implement changes to the base code to prevent this. These changes would result in all mods becoming incompatible and needing to be updated. We apologize for the inconvenience, but this is a necessary step to ensure a secure and stable gaming experience for everyone. After we release the 1.10 update, we will focus on improving performance and fixing bugs in the 1.10b build, which will finally include the modding support.

[h3]1.10 update[/h3]

The next update, including the highly anticipated controller support, will be available for testing on our experimental branch [b]tomorrow[/b]. While the UI is still a work in progress, we are eager to hear your feedback and incorporate it into the final version. The update also features 20 new items, ranging from placeables to weapons. To keep the discussion organized, we encourage players to share their thoughts and report any bugs they encounter on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/longvinter][b]discord [/b][/url]channel "🧪-experimental-longvinter". By doing so, we can ensure that issues with the experimental build are properly addressed and separated from the stable version. We will also inform you about the new updates in this channel

See the image below on how to switch to the experimental version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/38ebf27d7cebbc13d54ada584a6d2e63b7e21494.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #29
notes.content:
This is the first devlog of 2023. Happy New Year, everyone! We hope that you had a wonderful holiday season and are ready to take on the new year with renewed energy and excitement.

We're hard at work on the new update and we can't wait to share some new details with you!

[h2]Asian server wipes[/h2]

We understand that the decision to wipe the Asian server may have caused some disappointment for our players. However, we felt it was necessary in order to address the significant lag issues caused by duplication glitches that were being exploited by some players. These glitches allowed a small number of players to acquire large amounts of in-game currency, which created an unfair advantage and negatively impacted the overall gaming experience for others. We have now taken steps to fix these bugs and believe that wiping the server is the most effective solution to improve performance. It's important to note that unofficial servers are not affected by this decision. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding as we work to improve the overall quality of the game.

[h2]Next update[/h2]

We're excited to share some of the new features and improvements that will be included in our upcoming update. While we can't give a specific release date just yet, we want to give you a better understanding of the progress we've made and what still needs to be done before the update is ready to be rolled out. Here are some of the new things you can expect to see in the next update:

[h2]New weapons[/h2]

The long-awaited machine gun is finally coming, as well as three additional weapons will be included in the next update. While the models for all four weapons are complete, the crossbow will require the addition of a new ammo type before it can be added to the game. In the meantime, here are some preview images of all the new weapons to whet your appetite!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f5bc2be63e2093d6740cf8b7f5ac08e24629a3c6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/00dfb72e8742aedfd5d7ed67504cfa1df907327e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/8b0d865fc1eb36a34a0ddd016b9f9484af020ce4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/c0cd610c8c5880625fe4e937f55f46c543de0ae6.png[/img]

[h2]Disassembly machine[/h2]

Are you tired of being stuck without the necessary components to craft your desired weapons? We have some exciting news for you! The next update will introduce the ability to disassemble other weapons that are crafted with Long Gun Barrels via the new Disassembly machine, giving you the option to obtain the parts you need without ever leaving the house. The machine uses electricity so you need to plan accordingly. You can dismantle anything that is crafted with this machine, there is a small chance that some components are lost during the dismantling process. Only the model is ready so we still need to implement interaction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f76325b996ad5c71dec3bd44b2414cc5bdbc0ee4.png[/img]

[h2]Advanced workbench[/h2]

The upcoming update will introduce the advanced workbench, which will enhance the crafting system by increasing the number of required components for certain items. This change may make obtaining some items take more time, but it also allows us to better distinguish between early-game and late-game items by still utilizing basic crafting materials such as wood and metal parts. This will create a more nuanced and engaging crafting experience for players, allowing for a greater sense of progression and accomplishment as they progress through the game. For this one as well only the model is ready so we still need to implement interaction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f6131896f685bd0b233794235f867cb8745dbba4.png[/img]

[h2]Modding support[/h2]

In the upcoming update, we will be releasing a portion of the game's source code, allowing the community to create their own mods using Unreal Engine. This is a huge step forward for us and we can't wait to see the creative and innovative mods the community will create. To facilitate this, we will be releasing full modding tutorials and adding a dedicated tab for modded servers in the server browser. Additionally, we have already made progress in implementing a modding package manager, and we're currently working on figuring out the best way to handle installation and integration with Steam Workshop. This is an exciting time for the community and we look forward to seeing the new possibilities and experiences that mods will bring to the game.

[h2]Controller support[/h2]

We are excited to announce that controller support is finally coming to Longvinter, a feature that our players have been requesting since the game's launch. With this update, players will have the option to play the game in a more relaxed and comfortable way. We understand that controller support is important to many players, and we're glad to be able to make this feature a reality.

notes.title: Devlog #28
notes.content:
The holiday season is coming quickly and we have prepared a small update for you before the big 1.10 update next year. This one focuses on quality-of-life changes and bug fixes so you could have a smooth experience during holidays. And we have an event coming with a new limited-time hat and gun!

[h2]Q&A session with devs in discord next week![/h2]
Have some questions about the future of the game or existing mechanics? Come ask them from devs in our discord. We will answer all the questions live on 7.12.2022 from 06-08 UTC. If you cannot attend. We will open the text channel a day before the session so you can drop the question beforehand and it will get answered when we start.

[h2]Weather effects[/h2]

Rain and snowing are now added to the game and I personally really love the feeling that the snowing gives to the game. Snow now covers placeables placed in the snow region during snow storms to add an extra level of detail to the world. Here are the current final versions of both effects.

[previewyoutube=j-JxzzduQsM;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=ysyIKitJ0nw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Reindeers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/916ddc8394b1a553d7246775bea180fbb7fd83d3.png[/img]

Our second animal type is now in the game! This took a very long because the wolf has not been completed yet. But don't worry we will get the wolf ready for the 1.10 update. 


[h2]Changes[/h2]

We have had great suggestions in our discord community suggestions channel and some of the changes have come directly from the community!

[list]
[*]Cursor/dot size option slider
[*]Increase the quest rewards
    - Compendium reward 6K -> 10K
    - Farming basics gives another slab planter
    - Added a hatchet to starting quest reward
    - Farming support funds increase both 50%
[*]/mk 100, admin command that adds money
[*]/rain, admin command that starts raining.
[*]Generator sounds now have a separate volume slider in the audio settings tab
[*]30-minute cooldown for tent dismantle
[*]Make turrets non-walkthrough, but make turrets not placeable right next to each other anymore

notes.title: Devlog #27
notes.content:
Hello everyone. It has been a while since the last devlog, don't worry this does not mean we have slowed down the development. Let's go over some things we have been working on.

[h2]Weather effects[/h2]
To make our world feel more alive next step for us is to add snowfall and rain to the world. Here is an early look at the new raining effect
[previewyoutube=VDgwmEpcZ60;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
Since the holiday season is coming we want to make the experience as smooth as possible and we have been going through our GitHub issues and finally dealing with small problems that have been in the game for a really long time. We still don't know why some players lose all their progression because it happens to relatively few people and we have not been able to identify a clear pattern on this issue.

If you experience any bugs you can report them in [url=https://github.com/Uuvana-Studios/longvinter-windows-client]GitHub[/url] We know that it's a bit tedious to make an account in order to post but we want these to be available for everyone to view and comment on.

[h2]Next year[/h2]
Here is a rough idea of what we have been planning in terms of updates. We will release a small update next month with about 7 new items and other quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes. Our next big update is targeted to release early next year. This will feature full modding support, new guns and other game-changing items so stay tuned for more information coming about this next in the following months!

notes.title: Devlog #26
notes.content:
Halloween is coming!

While we are preparing for the new bigger update we wanted to give you a small quality of life update with some new Halloween items!

[h2]Halloween themed steam items[/h2]

During Halloween, you can earn 3 steam items while playing the game. All items are granted after 3 hours of playing on a server. Once they are in your Steam inventory you can equip them from the character customizer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/5cb63d9316f83e8aa00bf0ce362c86bde7f25376.png[/img]

[h2]Pumpkins and Scarecrows[/h2]

A new pumpkin plant has been added and you can find it in the Autumn region. Some vendors buy/sell the new plant. You can use the pumpkin to craft it into a pumpkin lantern!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/04e5b5c26edd05b8b289f16bf1550a109fb87536.jpg[/img]

[h2]Sell by long press[/h2]

No longer you have to press the same button 15 times if you have an inventory full of items you want to sell. You can now sell all by just long pressing the sell button.

[previewyoutube=R64sFcV-K24;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New camera angle[/h2]

One of the most requested features, since we launched the game, has been an altered camera angle to see behind houses and other objects that block the view. You can now change to the new top-down view by pressing "Q"

[previewyoutube=7lhRqzB6Su8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Add buy orders to your own vendor[/h2]

I think the player-maintained vendors are one of the coolest things that we have in the game. Vendors have had a UI overhaul and a new feature to allow you to buy items from other players and collect them later.

[previewyoutube=WXZSUxJ1tkg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Settings[/h2]

Every input is now mappable in the input settings tab. Also, we have added new settings to the general settings tab.
[list]
[*]Hide the home location indicator
[*]Hide team member location indicators
[*]Automatic inventory opens after placing an item for those who want to quickly place fences etc!
[*]Character reset button that allows you to reset your character if you have had a bug where you camera is stuck in the void
[/list]

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
Here is a list of other changes we added
[list]
[*] Re-balanced the shotgun.
    - Reduced damage by 35%
    - Less scatter to make it more accurate in the medium range
[*]2 new fishing reels to add more variety for choosing your fishing equipment
[*]Changed the Container saving method to the same one that we use for saving placeables. Hopefully, this prevents future data loss on containers
[*]You can now open a map by pressing "M" if you have one in your inventory
[*]Lover the generator sound levels
[*]Turrets should no longer shoot fences that are blocking the way
[*]Show item name when hovering over them with the mouse
[*]Unofficial servers can change how long it takes for a container to respawn
   - Use ChestRespawnTime variable name in GM_Longvinter default is 600(seconds)
[*]Empty click is now played if you fire your gun without ammo
[*]Changed bunker entering sound
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog #25
notes.content:
After quite a rocky start, update 1.0.9 is now relatively stable and significant issues have been resolved including the memory leak and birds running in water. I wanted to give you an insight into what we plan to do with the next updates.

[h2]Quality of life over content[/h2]

After a big content update, we feel that is appropriate to now focus more on making the current experience feel more polished and fluent. Next update (1.0.9b) we will focus on adding more settings and options to customize your gameplay

[h2]Weekly wipe servers to monthly wipe[/h2]

Our most dedicated players have stated that they wish monthly wipes would come back because they run out of things to do in the game. The most ideal situation would be that there would be endless stuff to do in the game and we will try to address this in the following updates. As a short-term solution, we decided to make current weekly wipe servers into monthly wipe servers and see if are those more popular than our normal servers.

[h2]Next update on trello board[/h2]

Our next update is coming in next month. And we will try to get it in experimental in two weeks. It will feature basic features that games usually have ready even before early access but better late than never. Every key will be remappable and we will add new general settings to hide optional UI elements and for example make auto-opening inventory after placing the item on the ground an option for those who spent a lot of time building.

[b]If you have some quality of life setting ideas that you would like implemented feel free to suggest them in the comments![/b]

Follow the [url=https://trello.com/b/Ixvlmrle/longvinter-roadmap]roadmap [/url] to see what settings will be added to the update!

notes.title: 1.0.9 Update and Devlog #24
notes.content:
Hello there. The long waited update is finally here and we will be focusing on that mostly in this week's devlog.

[h2]Weekly wipe server changing to bi-weekly[/h2]
Players who enjoy playing on servers that are wiped frequently. We felt like one week was too short a time and those servers are very unpopulated so we wanted to extend the wipe cycle by a week to give more time to play on a single cycle. We will be changing them to only[b] wiping them every other week[/b] to give more time to play before wiping.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[b]Check out the updated video![/b]
[previewyoutube=daxzB8x93Uk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*]10 new islands were added around the existing map

[*]Drivable boats that are found on the chest and around the map

[*]Hostile NPCs
[*]Bunkers

    - Tea and coffee bottles
    - 2 drivable boats
    - Solar panel with battery
    - Water sprinkler
    - 3 new fish

[h2]Changes[/h2]

notes.title: Friday Devlog #23
notes.content:
New update is coming together nicely and almost all features are now on experimental for testing. Lets go over the new things that you can all play on 1.0.9 update that is now [b]scheduled to arrive in 16.9.2022.[/b]

[h2]New blueprint system[/h2]

Some items that you previously could not craft are now added to the new blueprint catalogue found in the Compendium tap. There are now 2 new items that relate to this: "Research Document" and "Research Blueprint". After you have found 4 documents by completing new quests that are found from some vendors. You can craft a Blueprint that you can study and learn one of the items in the Blueprint category.

notes.content:
Hello all. Official servers were all wiped today hopefully for the last time. The next update is still under development but the bigger map should not require a wipe so we will update the game when we have all things ready for it.

notes.title: Friday Devlog #20
notes.content:
20 devlogs released already. Time flies so fast and I'm so proud to look back on how far we have come.

Since the game was released we have doubled the item count in the game. Added electricity and other upgrade options to the tents. Character customization, quests, teams, and other great features that have really improved the game and made it already a much smoother experience.

This week's devlog will still be quite dry in terms of images but I am sure next time I have some nice concrete things to show you.

[h2]Next official server wipe[/h2]

The next official server wipe will be on 19.8.2022. 

[h2]Boats and bigger map[/h2]

We feel like now is the right time to make the map bigger and finally try to stop wiping progression. We have already finished the layout of the map expansion. This will have the same islands that are currently present on the map but we are adding new islands around them. There will be a total of 10 new islands that can be explored. Also, a number of smaller islands are added to go alongside new boats.

All the compendium vendors are moving away from Sgt. Lake base camp and are given their own islands. These islands will require you to complete half of the compendium in order to enter the area and they will have some activities related to the compendium.

[h2]Bunkers and enemies[/h2]

We want to make the looting areas more interesting and we are adding underground bunkers that can be accessed by an elevator that is found inside the buildings in POI

We have also been preparing to introduce hostile NPCs to the game to make PVE more interesting. When combining both the new underground parts for the point of interest and enemy NPCs, we need to rethink how loot is distributed over different areas and there will be changes to them as well. Currently finding weapons is far easier than finding parts and crafting them. Weapon drops will become much rarer and we keep the weapon part drops the same.

[h2]When next update is relased?[/h2]

We currently don't want to give any exact date on when the next update is released. But when we update new things to experimental it usually takes 2 weeks to iron out all the issues that come up from experimental.

notes.title: Friday Devlog #19
notes.content:
I hope everyone is having a wonderful weekend. The summer sale is now over but we have had a good increase in our daily player numbers and I love seeing new players try and experience the game first time. Please leave a comment and share how did the new starter quest help you get started on the game?

We will be increasing the time we work on each major update. I feel like it has allowed us to plan better and make updates include more features and items. The more time a new update has in experimental the more stable it usually is when we push to the LIVE environment.

Our next scheduled [b]WIPE for all official servers will be on 17.7.2022[/b]. We want to make the map bigger before we move away from the monthly wipes. We also have heard your request for an [b]official PVE server[/b] and we will be making one in the following weeks so stay tuned for that!

Let's talk about what is coming next!

[h2]More quests and hair styles[/h2]

Now that we have added the quest system and character customization. We want to expand and add new quests and hairstyles with each update. The next update will have a couple of new hairstyles for female and male characters.

1.0.8 was focused on adding new items to decorate your house with. We want to focus more on adding different locations to the map to make exploring more interesting. Here is a couple of new building we will be using.

notes.title: Friday Devlog #18
notes.content:
I have to apologize for releasing this devlog a bit late because of personal stuff but better late than never!

The summer sale has just started and it's so great to see so many new players trying out our game. I'm reading reviews and discussions on the game constantly and I want to hear and improve the game from your feedback. The [b]server browser and stability update[/b] has been keeping the game relatively stable. We are planning to get the 1.0.8 to STABLE end of this week. You can try most of the features out now in the experimental branch already, lets's go over some main things!

-Nilsson

[h2]New items[/h2]

[h3]Pack of worms and blackberries[/h3]

A couple of new consumable items that make you get better drops from fishing.

[h3]Weather station[/h3]

A second new fishing-related item that you can buy when you have found all fishes for the compendium. It consumes electricity and lets you sell weather data from your area and earn Mk passively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/821e49b673f2f88f63278586e7be48b5f32c5a18.png[/img]

[h3]Hiking backpack[/h3]

This new item increases your inventory size when equipped. This rare item is added to the arena loot box.

[h3]Indoor placeables[/h3]

We are adding a ton of new items that you can decorate the interior of your house. Don't worry we are going to add a lot more things to house upgradability down the line to make you have a bigger home to decorate!

[h2]Home management tab[/h2]

We added a couple of new functionalities to the workbench. You will be able to change your door code and set turrets to passive mode.

Turret passive mode lets people come inside your yard without turrets attacking them. But if they raise weapons turrets will activate. So just like they work outside the house area currently. You can set all turrets to passive all individual ones by clicking on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/5ed2cb96869908cf2a5f071b3a95ec822e09dced.png[/img]

[h2]Quest system[/h2]

Right now the game does not do any hand-holding for the player and we still like giving the player freedom to play in their own way. But we feel like for new players some guidance at the very start would make a huge difference to make the learning process feel less overwhelming. The quest system for now will not have any story elements to it. This way we can easily implement it and add multiple things quickly that will make players have more ways to play in the sandbox.

The starting "quest line" we are adding soon is a series of tasks that the player is given at the very beginning when a player joins a new island. This will guide them on how to make their first marks (Mk) and buy and set up a tent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/cec31f6524d2906dfa38574ac9d89f6a13d10a31.png[/img]

[h2]Check out the 1.0.8 in the experimental branch![/h2]

Here's how you can participate:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/38ebf27d7cebbc13d54ada584a6d2e63b7e21494.png[/img]

[b]Experimental servers are only in US and EU regions.[/b]

notes.title: Friday Devlog #17
notes.content:
Hi you all. New character customization and the trading update seems to have received a warm welcome. There is still a couple of issues with the player-owned vendors but these will be ironed out in the next update.

[b]NOTE: Only official servers are affected by wipes. Unofficial server owners can decide for themselves when to wipe their servers[/b]

Next week there is the next scheduled wipe (17.6.2022) that we have planned. We are slowly but surely moving away from wipes and implementing the decay as a solution to preventing house overflow on servers.

This month we are going to have [b][u] update 1.0.7b next week [/u][/b] to go alongside the [b]official [/b]server wipe.
And [b][u]a bigger 1.0.8 update[/u][/b] which I will talk more about in next chapters.

-Nilsson

[h2]Server browser improvements[/h2]

We are going to add information about the server in the server browser that will help you decide which server is the best place to start your new adventure!

We are adding a [u][b]PVP filter[/b][/u] that lets you find only peaceful islands that have turned Player Versus Player combat OFF in the server settings. These islands are wonderful places to start as a new player if you just want to learn or just hang out!

Also, we are adding a percentage that tells you [b][u]how much space is still available[/u][/b] on the island before you jump in. This lets you avoid servers that don't have space to put down even a single tent.

notes.title: Friday Devlog #16
notes.content:
The new update is coming along really nicely. It still needs some time in development, but we will update the game next week. Let's see what new things will be coming in next week's update. We are aware that some official servers are having performance issues and we will do maintenance during the next wipe.

-Nilsson

[h2]Character Customization[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

Long waited customization is finally implemented. You can now choose between all the colors that were in the game before. And as an added feature there are now different hair styles that you can choose from and change color. You can test it out in the experimental build of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/cb05d71849eaf0b3645c60cdd5a33c72d704c798.png[/img]

[h2]Player Trading[/h2]

We wanted to add two different ways to trade with other players. You can invite people to trade with you by clicking and selecting the "trade" option from the menu. This will open a trading menu where you can exchange items and Mk safely. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/9070114588b8cfd98e60eddfde61f396f1f36839.png[/img]

A second way to trade items is to set up your own shop next to your house by placing down a new player vendor item! The vendor has to be placed on the border of your property so other players can safely shop. You can add any items inside the vendor and set a price that you think is the best.

[h2]Placeable Solar Panels[/h2]

The next in line for electricity generation is peaceable solar panels. These are not as useful for powering turrets because they only work during the day. We will soon add items that do not require constant electricity flow in order to be useful. 

Here in the picture, you can also see a new model of the Code locked gate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/8142399209c11fee416ab3727887ff5934d2f9ef.png[/img]


[h2]Test all these new features early in the experimental branch![/h2]

Here's how you can participate:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/38ebf27d7cebbc13d54ada584a6d2e63b7e21494.png[/img]

[b]Experimental servers are only in US and EU regions.[/b]

notes.title: Friday Devlog #15
notes.content:
Hello, I hope everyone is having a wonderful spring. Now that we have finally got most of the features of EOS to the current standard. I have had more time to focus on gameplay and balance. Our team has expanded now and it is starting to show off in bigger updates. I'm very optimistic about what the future will hold for the game!


-Nilsson

[h2]Wipes[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

NOTE: wipes only affect official servers with a blue checkmark. Unofficial servers can choose and decide their own wipes.

Now because house decay has been implemented we want to move the bi-weekly wipe to a monthly wipe. So the next wipe after today will be in [b]17.6.2022[/b]

[h2]House Decay[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

I added a second tab to the workbench window, this one is called decay. The idea is not to make it like a job to keep your house running. Now the house "consumes" 1 wood in 3 hours. Max capacity it can hold is 60. And once the wood has run out the house needs to be without wood for 24 hours before it decays. This makes it take about 7 days for a house to decay if there is no upkeep. Keep in mind that this can be disabled with the same setting that disables tent decay. Also, houses will not decay if the server is off.

I want to hear your feedback about this so comment down below what you think about this!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/00b3b08e216fc238ce7dc8f4c0aa0cd5858039b9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/8a6ea082fd5a4b5f521667a50676cbfc9d42c377.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Placing helpers[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

I added the first two helper shapes while placing the turret and tent. The turret now shoots only players who walk to the house area. I wanted to add an indication element that better illustrates this area. Here are pictures of this in action

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/6370c2829dde623307b92d5f1388c0de34964409.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/abd7e4631408e49b840ee956bce27a2f744d612e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dedicated server tool on steam and video tutorial[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

I always wanted to Longvinter to be something that can be easily experienced with friends. I have now created a full tutorial on how to setup the server and configure it!

[previewyoutube=hJY2UUQCsrQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Placeable electricity generator[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/74dbf855653909900d462f3e43fdc28160620e13.jpg[/img]

There is now a peaceable generator in the kyrre's equipment shop that you can buy and place near your house. This will require fuel to run and generates 40 electricity while near a house. Please note that an electricity transmitter is required in order for turrets to work.

[h3]Here are all the changes in a nice list format:[/h3]

New features:

[list]
[*]Added turret range indicator when placing the turret.
[*]Added base building area indicator while placing a tent
[*]Added House decay to the bases.
    - Decay wood stack will have 60 wood and it takes 3 hours to consume 1 wood
    - After all, wood is decayed, it will take 24 hours before base is destroyed. All items inside the house will be gone but outside placeables can be picked up by others
    - This can be disabled with tentDecay server parameter
[*]Added generator placeable which generates 40 electricity while turned ON. Note that house requires electricity transmitter for turrets to work
[/list]

Balance changes:

[list]
[*]Increased cake base price by 50% to make it worth more than the ingredients
[*]Made Redfish and Black Grouper from Rare to Epic they don't spawn in Julia’s Mysterios shop anymore
[*]Increased Metal parts base price from 20mk to 100mk
[*]Removed Mysterios bag from spawning into Julia’s Mysterios shop
[*]Made Julia’s Mysterios items selling and buying price increase / decrease much faster when players buy items from the vendor. This makes it that the first person who arrives to shop after catalogue reset is rewarded more. This allows other users to buy / sell to vendors but with a heavy price increase. This is the same system that is on other vendors but on overdrive.
[*]Electricity changes:
    - Removed passive 30 electricity
    - Changed house fuel generator output from 80 → 110
    - Changed Win turbine output from 30→ 50
    - Changed solar panel output from 20 → 25
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Closing the chat with Esc should now work
[*]Shooting is now more reliable near objects (Firing cooldown is not started if the gun doesn't actually fire)
[*]Tents can no longer be placed inside houses or in the void
[*]Fishing rods should no longer disappear when switching equipment
[*]Zooming in and out should now work after using the admin panel
[*]The player should now be able to move when spawning in water
[*]Increased house exit attempts when dismantling to make exiting more reliable
[*]Fixed "Show Names" in admin panel. It now also shows names without the waving
[*]Warehouse roof should now go invisible when spawning inside the warehouse
[*]Last chat message no longer reappears after using a boat
[*]Fixed the bug where a character couldn't move if he died while using the chat
[*]Fixed the bug where inventory didn't work after dying when trying to place an item
[*]Fixed placeables disappearing when dying while placing
[*]Increased the house enter attempts so house enter should now be more reliable
[*]Fixed player color and spawn location back to normal before EOS update
[*] Locally hosted servers can now be joined from server browser again
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 Notes
notes.content:
This week's update is here a bit early. Here are all the changes that made it in:

[list]
[*]Fixed the turret bug where they would shoot their owner while aiming down a gun
[*]Fixed the melee exploit
[*]Added "a share house with team" button in the workbench menu
[*]Made admin log events do line break instead of overflow
[*]Fixed a crash that was caused by discord not running on a machine
[*]Linux now enabled for EAC
[*]Achievements are now re-enabled
[*]Fixed energy drink exploit
[*]Fixed the vendor window opening twice bug
[*]Servers are now sorted by region in the server browser
[*]You can now also search servers by a tag if you created a custom one and want to find it quicker, check out the server documentation on how to add a tag to your server
[*]Changed tarp price from 5 -> 40 mk and made it from common to rare
[*]Decreased the Planter Box price by 30%
[*]Added an engine model next to the houses that have upgraded the Electrical Engine from their house upgrade menu
[/list]


Known issues:

[list]
[*]Ping is currently still not available in the server browser
[*]Continue button does not sometimes work correctly. It may throw you to the wrong server
[*]You cannot join the server that is run by the same machine running the game
[/list]

So why the ping is not shown in the server browser?

This is because now the server data is cached in the EOS network and all the server information is fetched from there and not directly from the server. Because of this design change, the ping is not embedded into the search and has to be queried manually. I have a solution for this but have not got it to work yet. The upside is that searching servers are much faster and more reliable than previously.


There is no wipe with this update. Next [b]WIPE will be 13.5.2022[/b]

notes.title: Friday Devlog #12
notes.content:
Hello again. It's time for another devlog again. Time flies super fast and I cannot believe it has already been a week since I returned from Lapland.

This week I made good progress on the team system. Although it is not completely ready I don't want to make you wait any longer for it. We also spend some time this week managing our company's bureaucracy work and other mandatory things.

We also are aware of the hackers that currently ruin many players' experiences. We will address this issue more in the coming weeks. For now, we will need to trust and thank our community admins for keeping the game clean from hackers as much as they can.

Currently, we can make new logic and mechanics way faster than we can make models and art in general, so we've started hiring. If you know any modellers, riggers, animators, UE4 devs, please ask them to send their prior work to this email: contact@uuvana.com

The header image is from community Discord user "elliot"

- Nilsson

[h2]Wipe schedule[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

For now, we see that the best practice to prevent the islands from filling with houses is to wipe the progress completely. This is only a temporary solution before we can implement a better decay system for houses. Wipes will be done bi-weekly so the next wipe will be on 22.4.2022.

[h2]Team system improvements[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

A big feature that we wanted to add is to know where your friends are and find them easily without the Satellite Communicator. Once you are far enough from your teammate the colored bubble indicates which direction they are in. The color matches the player's shirt color.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/a9b8f2cfa964c9d78f3d0d05d86600e11aa3932a.jpg[/img]

You also now gain score by picking up flowers, fishing and hunting birds. You can see your teammates and your own score on the new team tab that is accessible from your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/f0b7d699651de6d5f4b498780935e0c10c4f5725.jpg[/img]

[h2]Julia's Mysterious Shop[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

This was idea from discord user @Izanagi.

The mysterious shop has a changing catalogue that will re-roll every 90 minutes. These are located near points of interest and they sell and buy certain items for a specific time and are worth checking out every now and then. The machine shows in the description how much time until the new re-roll.

The house electricity update has been a big grind because they require a lot of metal parts and light bulbs. These items are already common and should spawn most often. But on populated servers loot is gone really quickly very often. This was a quick bandage fix before we could add player trading and a more dynamic economy that way.

You can separate these shops by their purple color as shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/024df1315b7641bdaf774383930b8ed0d28bfb45.png[/img]

[h2]Test new features early in the experimental branch![/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

Here's how you can participate:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/38ebf27d7cebbc13d54ada584a6d2e63b7e21494.png[/img]

notes.title: Friday Devlog #11
notes.content:
Hello everyone! As you might have noticed, there was no devlog last week, and we're going to start doing bi-weekly devlogs from now on. It makes more sense time management-wise, but also there is not enough content to show off every week, content that would be in such a state that it would look good in pictures. 

Nilsson is going camping to do some "research" for the entirety of the next week, a quick vacation that he truly deserves, so no bug fixes next week. I'll be here the whole week, as usual, working on the character customization and some other stuff that will probably bring a lot of new playability to the game.

Currently, we can make new logic and mechanics way faster than we can make models and art in general, so we've started hiring. If you know any modelers, riggers, animators, UE4 devs, please ask them to send their prior work to this email: contact@uuvana.com

The cover + header image is from community Discord user "xXKISCOYXx"

- Teo

[h2]Player feedback: March[/h2]
[h3]Teo[/h3]

I asked you guys and gals to complete a quick survey this week and some 160 of you participated, thanks a lot for that! The optional "tell us anything" was quite useful, and we read every single message you left there and contacted a couple of you that wanted to help us more! 

We asked you to pick one option out of the 5 that would make it easier for you to recommend the game to your friends and make it more fun. Here's how that went:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/24322b2e7a4394c4507a7976686cc4e0a3c1307c.png[/img]

Here's the split on hours played between participants:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/a879fe27bd6c5461b80d8d0e6110ec1efc16967f.png[/img]

PVP is the winner here, PVE being a close second. These are quite broad questions without going into details on what exactly you'd want, but that's alright since I believe we know what the game needs. Some of you also explained what it is, in particular, that is missing so that's nice.

We thought that fixing bugs would definitely be the biggest in percentage, but not at all. It's a given that they are fixed sooner or later, but I thought it was way more urgent than adding more content. Seems like I was wrong.

This data is quite useful to us, but more so the optional messages you left, so we'll probably continue doing this at the end of every month from this point on.

[h2]New team system[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

The first feature from our road map has started to take shape and you can already test the team system in the experimental branch.

You can invite anyone to your team by clicking them with your mouse.

We are currently ironing out the inviting, joining and kicking users from teams. After those actions are smooth we want to add additional features such as seeing the location of your other teammates even if they are offscreen.

We will also add a scoreboard where each team earns a rating that is based on their presence on the island.

Your teammates are now highlighted with green to help you identify them from hostiles

Here's what the UI will look like, minus some features:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/6d51325b5b84f48e3d6ee60f6bf9df9790f4d95c.png[/img]

Here's how it currently looks like in experimental:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/6bf4d7753063329a9a684bb719bc93f8d895d890.jpg[/img]

[h2]Test new features early in the experimental branch![/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

Here's how you can participate:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/38ebf27d7cebbc13d54ada584a6d2e63b7e21494.png[/img]

notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed Placing duplication glitch where you could place 2 items with left mouse and spacebar

notes.title: Friday Devlog #10
notes.content:
This update should be quite relieving for the high population servers. For starters, there's a whole new island next to the main-land, and secondly, tents now decay if not upgraded in time!

Personally, I feel like the speed at which new content is added is still not what it should be, mainly because of my time being divided between so many other equally as important things, and to add to it, those other important things, which are mostly business-related things, really eat away the creativity in a major way. I think we'll learn to manage that as we go forward and as things settle down a little bit!

Now that the damage control is mostly done, when will we get a [b]roadmap[/b], you may ask? Next week! 

I hope you enjoy this update. Please report any issues you may find on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/longvinter]Discord[/url]!

- Teo

[h2]New Island: Isla Inocentes[/h2]
[h3]Teo[/h3]
The new island is horizontally as large as the main-land but slimmer. It has new fish, a new plant, and a new vendor. I promised a new type of POI, but I sacrificed it for new fishes instead. The new POI is coming later, and the main-land AND this new island will be gradually filled with more interesting locations!

[h2]New House Upgrades[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

Workbench lets you now choose your energy production method. When you upgrade you can see your house's electricity production in the workbench tab. Currently electricity has no use. But next week's update will add electricity requirements for some items for example turrets and lights!

[h2]Tent Decay And No Wipe[/h2]
[h3]Nilsson[/h3]

Island has been packed with houses and new players are still having a hard time finding places to add their base. Now all the tents will decay after 48 hours. If you upgrade your base to a wooden cabin this will stop the decay process. In a future, we might add some kind of upkeep to the cabins also but we want to wait a week and see how this change affects the free building area.

You can view any tent's decay time by hovering the mouse over it. Keep in mind that server restart also resets the tent decay time.

notes.title: Friday Devlog #9
notes.content:
Issues with saving seem to be solved now, at least we haven't gotten any reports of progress resets on Discord, other than some random chests not spawning after a server restart, so here's hoping we fixed it, for now. 

There's a new tent limit that we wanted to test, so we wiped the official servers to see how it affects the available space on the island after a week.

I myself got to do a lot of new content this week, which is always cool, and I'll be showing some of that on this devlog!

- Teo

[h2]Dynamic vendor prices[/h2]

We wanted the game to feel more like a multiplayer game where player interactions have even more impact on the world around them. In today's update, we re-enabled the Vendor dynamic prices. This system has two main components one that changes prices randomly over time and the second which is affected by what is sold to a vendor and bought from a vendor. 

For example, if all the players are selling common pike fish to a single vendor its price will drop to a minimum of 50% of the original price. This will force people to either stash their fish and wait for a price to go back up and then sell in bulk. Or the player can try to find another vendor that buys the item for a better price.

[h2]Autumn Biome + Island[/h2]
[h3]Teo[/h3]

You'll have to start updating your community-made maps soon because there's a new island coming most likely next week, called "Isla Inocentes". it's horizontally as large as the mainland but vertically much slimmer. Right now the island is divided into 3 separate islands that are connected with building blocked bridges. 

This island will be the new home for the Capercaillie birds and mushrooms, which I'll hopefully get done by the end of next week. There will also be a new type of looting POI that players can explore, but more on that next week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/d60c1ddda8bcb4ac45242f493846af470e33fa5d.png[/img]
